description.en: In ancient times, there existed the land of Wa, split between the reign of the gods and the world of man. It was an age when gods and men existed together. Miyo, an orphan girl, spent her days trying to accept her upcoming death as the designated sacrifice for the god worshipped by her village, Kippuuson-no-Mikoto-no-Kami. However, her fate changed as she encountered En-no-Ozuno, a monk with supernatural abilities capable of conversing with the gods. An orphan girl, a great monk, and a demon boy. Follow their adventure as they encounter the gods, traveling through even dimension and time.
description.ja: 遥か昔の倭の国の、神代と人世のその間。神々が人間と共存していた時代。村を司る神・切風孫命神への生贄に選ばれた少女・妙（みよ）は、避けられぬ死に怯えていた。しかし、神と相対し対話する異能を持つ道士・小角（おづの）との出会いが、彼女を窮地から救い出す……！みなしごの少女と、壮麗の道士、そして鬼の少年。
description.pt-br:
Nos tempos antigos, existia a terra de Wa, dividida entre o reino dos deuses e o mundo dos homens. Era uma época em que deuses e homens viviam juntos.


Miyo, uma garota órfã, passava seus dias tentando aceitar sua morte iminente como o sacrifício designado para o deus adorado por sua aldeia, Kippuuson-no-Mikoto-no-Kami. No entanto, seu destino mudou quando ela encontrou En-no-Ozuno, um monge com habilidades sobrenaturais capaz de conversar com os deuses. 

Uma garota órfã, um grande monge e um garoto demônio. Acompanhe a aventura deles enquanto encontram deuses, viajando por diferentes realidades e eras.

altTitles.ja: ニーチェ先生~コンビニに、さとり世代の新人が舞い降りた~

description.en: The comedy manga follows a male part-time late-night convenience store worker named Matsukoma, and the new part-time worker he trains named Tomoharu Nii, nicknamed Nietzsche-sensei. Tomoharu is a university student in the school's Buddhism department. When an angry customer screams at Tomoharu, "Customers are gods!," he replies, "God is dead." The manga follows the part-time worker life of Matsukoma and Tomoharu, the latter of whom continuously baffles his customers and co-workers at the convenience store with his odd ways.

彼女代行として日々お金を稼ぐ女子大生と彼女に魅せられた男達の、恋愛のリアルを描くビターラブストーリー。

description.en: The story follows a dark place inside the world of the Baki series, the so-called "Amusement Park." The main character is Mumon Katsuragi, older brother of Katsumi. He ventures into a dark place where money is everything and lives are cheap, the "Amusement Park," motivated to find the killer of his mentor and master Taizan Matsumoto. The killer left a few trails behind and with his wits and physical prowess, he's been able to track him down to the ultimate dangerous fighting arena.
description.ja: 本格格闘小説の父・夢枕獏版『バキ外伝』、待望の漫画化ッッ！！刃牙ワールド×獏ワールド！！

description.en:
Saintess Militia regained her memories on a trip to the ladies' room! 
My name is Tosaka Kakeru—a high school boy, and, more importantly, I no longer have a certain vital something between my legs!! I had been reincarnated into the world of an otome game!!! What's more, my best friend Mori Fuuma, who had been hit by the same truck as me, had been reborn as Bellrose, a villainess practically drowning in death flags!!!! A Saintess-and-Villainess tag team (with two high school boys inside) sets out to completely conquer the game while romancing a cast of handsome men, and aiming for the one ending where they both survive!
description.ja: 聖女ミリティアはお花を摘みにいって思い出した！俺の名前は登坂カケル、男子高校生、そして股間に大事な何かがないことを!!乙女ゲームの世界に転生したことを!!!さらに共にトラックにはねられた親友・森風馬が死亡フラグだらけの悪役令嬢ベルローズとなっていたことを!!!!聖女と悪役令嬢タッグ（中身は男子高校生）がイケメンキャラ達と恋愛しながら、二人での生存ルートエンディングを目指して完全攻略いたしますわ！

title.en: I Became the Owner of a Poor Territory

altTitles.en: I Became the Lord of a Poor Territory
I Became the Owner of a Poor Estate

description.en: Drowning in debt, Donghee fell asleep in her tiny basement room, only to wake up as the lord of the impoverished Grace Estate. Facing a crumbling domain and overwhelming financial ruin, she must use her wits and determination to rebuild the territory from scratch and secure a prosperous future.
description.es-la: Ahogada en deudas, Donghee se quedó dormida en su pequeña habitación del sótano, solo para despertar como la señora del empobrecido Dominio Grace. Enfrentándose a unas tierras que se desmoronan y a una abrumadora ruina financiera, deberá usar su ingenio y determinación para reconstruir el territorio desde cero y asegurar un futuro próspero.

altTitles.ja: 大崎さんと小森さん

altTitles.en: Oosaki-san & Komori-san

altTitles.pt-br: Oosaki-san e Komori-san

description.en:
The huge, poker-faced Oosaki-san is intimidating at first glance, but she's actually gentle and shy. Joining her at work is the new part-timer, the petite and friendly 147cm Komori-san.
Despite their appearances and personalities being total opposites, they find themselves drawn to one another without even realizing...!
The awkward crybaby Oosaki-san is a carnivore of love, whereas the oblivious easy-going Komori-san is a total herbivore.

What lies in store on the path of love for this mismatched pair with a 50 centimeter height gap...?
description.pt-br:
A enorme e impassível Oosaki-san pode parecer intimidadora à primeira vista, mas na verdade ela é gentil e tímida. Juntando-se a ela no trabalho está a nova funcionária de meio período, a pequena e simpática Komori-san, de 147 cm.
Apesar de suas aparências e personalidades serem totalmente opostas, elas se veem atraídas uma pela outra sem nem perceberem...!
A desajeitada e chorona Oosaki-san é uma carnívora do amor, enquanto a despreocupada e tranquila Komori-san é uma herbívora completa.
O que o futuro reserva para esse par improvável com uma diferença de altura de 50 centímetros?

description.en:
The sequel to Konjiki no Gash!!, aka Zatch Bell.

Once the battle to decide the king of the demon world, in which 100 demon children fought against each other, had come to an end… the king of the demon world was crowned, and the demon world lived out the rest of its days in peace.

Or at least, that was how it was supposed to be.

Now, a shocking fact about the current state of the demon world comes to light. And in the depths of their despair, three demon children decide to risk it all for one last chance at survival.
description.it: Dopo la battaglia per decidere il re del mondo dei demoni, in cui 100 bambini demoni si sono combattuti tra loro... Fu deciso il re del mondo dei demoni e arrivarono giorni di pace... o almeno così si supponeva! Fatti scioccanti vengono rivelati sull'attuale mondo dei demoni. Al limite della disperazione, tre bambini demone fanno una scommessa!
description.pt-br: Uma vez terminada a batalha para decidir o Rei do mundo demoníaco, na qual 100 mamodos lutaram uns contra os outros… o Rei do mundo demoníaco foi coroado, e o mundo demoníaco viveu o resto de seus dias em paz.

description.en:
"In this realm mythological creatures roam, descendant of the nine heavens they call home." 

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. What kind of adventures will they take on?
description.th:
[เทพอสูรท่องมนุษย์ ดั้นเมฆามาจากเก้าชั้นฟ้า]

ยุคสมัยที่เทคโนโลยีก้าวหน้า ยุคทองของเหล่าเทพอสูรผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ในอดีตก็จบลง วันเวลาผ่านไปยิ่งอยู่อย่างกะโหลกกะลา 

“ซื่อปู้เซียง” เทพอสูรสายลุย ได้รับบัญชาให้ลงมายังโลกมนุษย์ เพื่อตามหาและช่วยเหลือเหล่าเพื่อนพ้องเทพอสูรที่ตกอับกระจัดกระจายอยู่บนโลก

พอมาถึงโลกมนุษย์ เขาก็ได้พบกับ “เทียนลู่” อดีตเพื่อนร่วมงานที่กำลังจนตรอกไร้ทางไป, “ทู่เย่” คอสุราสุดแป้กที่ชีวิตไม่เคยได้ดี 

และสองพี่น้องหยินเจียวจินเจียวที่โดนเนรเทศลงมาจากสวรรค์…

และแล้ว การเดินทางบทใหม่ของพวกเขาก็ได้เริ่มต้นขึ้น!
description.zh:
《人间有神兽，来自九重天 》

随着科技的发展，往日威风凛凛的神兽们日子大不如前。神兽四不像奉命下凡，去解救流落人间的落魄神兽。在凡间，他遇到了走投无路的老同事天禄，不得志的酒友兔爷，被贬下凡的金银角兄弟……从此开启了一段新的旅程。
description.es-la:
"En este reino, criaturas mitológicas deambulan, descendientes de los nueve cielos que llaman hogar."
Sibuxiang, un hombre-ciervo mitológico y perezoso, es expulsado del cielo y asignado a apoyar a las criaturas mitológicas que vagan por el mundo humano. Conoce y vive aventuras con sus amigos: el enérgico Pixiu amante de la comida llamado Pipi, el fanático conejo lunar Tony, los hermanos ratones Jinjiao y Yinjiao, también desterrados del cielo, y muchos otros. ¿Qué tipo de aventuras emprenderán?
description.pt-br:
"Neste reino, criaturas mitológicas vagam, descendentes dos nove céus que chamam de lar.”

Sibuxiang, um mítico homem-cervo preguiçoso, é expulso do céu e recebe a missão de ajudar as criaturas mitológicas que vagam pelo mundo humano. Ele conhece e vive aventuras com seus amigos: o energético e faminto Pixiu chamado Pipi, o fanático coelho da Lua, Tuye, os irmãos ratos banidos do céu Jinjiao e Yinjiao, e muitos outros. Que tipo de aventuras eles viverão?

description.en:
Dan Hiroki, the Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's 1st Investigation Division. An elite among elites with a brilliant career, his hidden face is that of a serial killer who enacts vigilante justice upon sinful villains.

This is the second official spin-off of "Trace: Reminiscences of a Forensic Scientist." The devil's pleasurable record of condemnation, preying on the wicked, begins.

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)
description.ja: 警視庁刑事部捜査第一課長、壇浩輝。輝かしいキャリアを持つエリート中のエリートである彼の裏の顔は、罪深い悪人に私刑を下すシリアルキラーだった。 『トレース 科捜研法医研究員の追想』公式スピンオフ作品第2弾。 悪人を餌食にする、悪魔の快楽断罪録、開幕——。

"Fulfilling meal... a familiar view.”

In this story, Fate and food meet in a delicious and gentle world. It's nothing but an ordinary meal scene... Delicious meals are served at the Emiya's dinner table every day, through spring, summer, fall and winter. – Let's see... what's for dinner today?
description.ja: 衛宮士郎が自慢の手料理で、冬木の住人やサーヴァントたちをほっこりさせちゃいます！ 詳細なレシピも付いて、だれでも士郎の手料理を同調開始（トレース・オン）！

description.en: A pretty girl, Tamura Nagisaki, appears before an ordinary high school boy. When she says, "Will you protect me?", his ordinary life is thrown into a tailspin. The pleasure killer, Dimensional Rider, kills Nagisaki without a motive. With Nagisaki's death, time between the two loops back and forth. Can the two escape the carnage and infinite loops…?

description.en: Fogland, a mysterious international prison, traps Dante Kang a science teacher sent to reform prisoners during a sudden riot, leaving him with only one way to escape: by becoming a leader.

description.en:
Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. 

Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! 

Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

---
***Note:** LINE Webtoon (Official English) has made changes to the main character's "original emotional facial expressions" in some chapters like for examples, CH.01, CH.02 and CH.06 is changed while it's kept in all other official language platforms.*
description.fr: Après avoir fini son jeu préféré «L'Épéiste raté de Sylvania» plus de cinq fois, un joueur se retrouve aspiré au début de l'histoire pour la recommencer dans le rôle ingrat d'un méchant personnage secondaire, détesté de tous et renié par sa famille, avec lequel il devra composer pour survivre à l'académie!
description.id: Kehidupanku berubah saat menjadi tokoh antagonis ekstra game favoritku. Padahal aku hanya ingin hidup santai tanpa ambisi, tapi sulit sekali bertahan di dunia ini. Pokoknya aku harus bertahan hidup dengan cara yang tak terbayangkan oleh para pemeran utama!
description.it: Ed Rothstaylor è un antagonista di terza categoria, ripudiato dalla sua famiglia e cacciato dai dormitori per i suoi misfatti. Un giorno, il nostro protagonista si sveglia nei panni di questo stesso Ed, e realizza di dover ottenere una borsa di studio così da potersi diplomare ed essere sistemato per il resto della sua vita. Costretto a vivere nei boschi, decide di stare alla larfa dai protagonisti, ma quattro delle ragazze principali non vogliono lasciarlo in pace. Non solo questo, la sua presenza inizia ad alterare la linea temporale e gli eventi del gioco! Riuscirà Ed ad aiutare la storia a proseguire, mentre si tiene lontano dai riflettori?
description.ja: 好きだったゲームの三流エキストラ悪役に転生してしまった。 野望はなく、ただおとなしく暮らしたい。しかしこの世は、生き残るのが本当に大変だ。 主人公にはできない三流悪役のやり方で、俺はこの物語の結末を迎えるために生き残るぞ！
description.ko:
즐겨하던 게임의 삼류 엑스트라 악역으로 빙의했다.
야망은 없고 그냥 조용히 살고 싶다. 근데 세상이 참 살아남기 힘들다.
주인공이 할 수 없는 삼류 악역의 방식으로, 난 이 이야기의 끝을 맞이하기 위해 살아남는다!
description.pl: Ed Rothstaylor to trzeciorzędny złoczyńca w grze, wyrzucony przez swoją rodzinę i wyrzucony z akademika za swoje złe uczynki. Pewnego dnia nasz główny bohater budzi się jako właśnie ten Ed i zdaje sobie sprawę, że musi zdobyć stypendium, aby ukończyć szkołę i zapewnić sobie przyszłość. Teraz mieszkając w lesie, postanawia trzymać się z dala od protagonistów, ale cztery z głównych bohaterek nie dają mu spokoju. Co więcej, jego obecność zaczyna zmieniać fabułę i wydarzenia w grze! Czy Ed pomoże w rozwoju historii, pozostając w cieniu?
description.ru:
Эд Лостейлор — третьесортный злодей в игре, отвергнутый семьей и изгнанный из общежития за свои проступки. Судьба делает неожиданный поворот, когда наш герой пробуждается в теле этого самого Эда и осознаёт: единственный путь к благополучному будущему — получить стипендию и окончить обучение.

Обосновавшись в лесной глуши, он твёрдо решает держаться подальше от главных героев игры. Однако четыре прекрасные героини словно заворожены им и никак не желают оставить его в покое. Более того, само его существование начинает искажать временную линию, меняя предначертанный ход событий!

Удастся ли Эду сохранить баланс между невмешательством и необходимостью двигать сюжет вперёд, оставаясь при этом в тени? Ведь каждое его действие может изменить судьбу целого мира...
description.zh:
从恶棍到生存王
打破命运的束缚！
意外穿成游戏中的三流反派，只想安稳低调地活下去。但这个世界却生存艰难！无法像主角那样光芒万丈，只能用三流反派的方式，在故事的尽头努力活下来！
description.pt-br: Eu possuía um personagem vilão extra de terceira categoria em meu jogo favorito. Não tenho ambições e só quero viver uma vida tranquila. Mas, caramba, este mundo é um lugar difícil de sobreviver. Eu sobreviverei até o final desta história, de uma forma que o protagonista não conseguirá. Sobreviverei à maneira de um personagem vilão de terceira categoria.
description.zh-hk: 轉生到自己最喜歡的遊戲後，我成為了不起眼的三流反派角色。雖然只想安安靜靜地生活，但是在這個世界很難生存下去。我沒什麼野心，目標就只有從學院畢業。 為了迎接這個故事的結局，我會用主角做不到的三流反派方式活下來！

description.en: A 40-year-old virgin man working for a black company has never been with a girl, let alone married one. Having nothing to do but love cute girls, one day he loses consciousness during an all-nighter of work――. When he wakes up... he finds himself reborn as "Norun," a male with cat ears, in another world full of animal-eared girls, where there are far more females than males!!!? His cute fiancée, Misha, and other attractive girls with animal-ears who are potential brides appear before him one after the other――!?
description.ja: ブラック会社勤務の４０歳の童貞男子がある日、徹夜続きの労働中に意識を失い、目が覚めると…まさかの異世界転生！？メスが圧倒的に多いケモ耳女子だらけの社会で“ノルン”というケモ耳男子になっていた！！！？しかも、自分以外のオスたちは年に一度しか発情しない超草食系ばかり…。そんな世界で唯一自由に発情ができるノルンの前に、可愛い婚約者のミーシアや魅力的なお嫁さん候補のケモ耳娘たちが次々と現れて――！？こうして始まる“ノルン”の夢溢れる異世界ライフ♪ しかし、この世界にはある重大な秘密があった……！？

description.en:
Unable to sleep or find true satisfaction in his daily life, Yamori Kou begins wandering the night streets. He encounters a strange girl who offers to help soothe his insomnia by sleeping beside him, but it is not merely a one-way exchange…

---
- **Won the 68th Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen in 2023, which it shared alongside Blue Orchestra**
description.fr:
Incapable de trouver le sommeil ni d'être pleinement satisfait de son quotidien‚ Yamori Kou commence à errer de nuit dans les rues. Il fait la rencontre d'une étrange fille qui l'aidera à calmer ses insomnies en dormant à ses côtés‚ mais ce ne sera pas un simple échange unilatéral…

---

Maison d'édition FR : **Kurokawa**
description.ja: 恋と青春は、夜に生まれる＿＿さあ、たのしい夜ふかしの時間だ！不眠が続く中２・夜守コウは、初めて一人外に出た夜、美しい吸血鬼・七草ナズナと出会う。「今日に満足できるまで、夜ふかししてみろよ。少年」彼女との二人きりの夜ふかしがコウの運命を大きく変えていく＿＿「これは、僕が、七草ナズナに恋をするための物語だ」眠れない夜を過ごす全ての人へ贈る＿＿真夜中のボーイ・ミーツ・ガール！連載開始から超絶大反響！！ふたり　たのし　よふかし　ラブストーリー開幕！！
description.ru: Не в состоянии заснуть или найти что-то позитивное в своей жизни, Ямори Кой начинает бродить по ночному городу, где он встречает странную девушку, которая предлагает ему свою помощь в борьбе с бессонницей путем сна рядом с ним.
description.uk: Позбавлений можливості спати, не задоволений своїм повсякденним життям, Ко Яморі перестає ходити до школи та береться поночі блукати вулицями. Там він зустрічає дівчину, на ім’я Надзуна Нанакуса, котра надає життю Ко нову сутність; укусом у шию і наступним перетворенням його на вампіра.
description.es-la: Incapaz de dormir o encontrar satisfacción en su vida diaria, Yamori Kou comienza a explorar la ciudad por la noche, donde conoce a una extraña chica que le ofrece ayudarle con su insomnio durmiendo a su lado.

title.ja-ro: Drama na Koi wa Kihon kara

altTitles.ja: ドラマな恋は基本から

altTitles.en: Dramatic Love Starts from the Basics

description.en:
Shinji Yuuki is an ordinary businessman, 35 years old, single, no girlfriend, living at home. He is worried about his future as a single man, but he has little experience in love and is afraid of marriage activity. But when he meets a female doctor, he falls in "love beyond his imagination," a love that turns his life upside down!
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/kaisha_suki)
description.ja: 「35歳独身、彼女なし、実家暮らし」の平凡なサラリーマン・悠木慎史。独りで生きる未来に不安があるけれど、恋愛経験は少ないし婚活も怖い――。そんな悠木が、とあるアクシデントで医師・伴瑛理子と出会い、人生がひっくり返る「想像以上の恋」に落ちる！
description.pt-br:
A vida de Shinji Yuuki dá uma guinada inesperada quando ele conhece uma médica, despertando um amor que desafia seus medos e incertezas. Seu mundo ordinário como empresário é jogado no caos, à medida que esse novo afeto o tira da zona de conforto e o obriga a enfrentar suas ansiedades mais profundas sobre relacionamentos e o futuro.

Há alguma direção específica que você gostaria que essa história tomasse, ou desafios particulares que Shinji possa enfrentar ao navegar por esse romance inesperado?

High School Iron Fist Legend: TOUGH

description.en: Nobody enjoys a good fight more than "Kiibo" Miyazawa, a high school student whose father is training him in the family's secret martial art. Kiibo dreams of becoming the next Bruce Lee, but his awesome fighting skills may soon surpass his idol's!
description.ja: キー坊こと宮沢熹一は見た目はヤンキーでケンカも大好きだが、実は純情でお人好しな高校生。ある日、キー坊は、トラックをたった5分で解体した“阿修羅のように”強い男・黒田光秀と出会う。黒田と戦うため、特訓を始めるキー坊だが…!?
description.pt-br: Ninguém gosta mais de uma boa luta mais do que Kiibo Miyazawa, um estudante do ensino médio, cujo pai sempre o treina na arte marcial secreta da família. Kiibo tem o sonho de se tornar o próximo Bruce Lee, mas com as suas habilidades de combate impressionantes, em breve ele poderá superar o seu ídolo!

description.en:
Welcome to Yani's apartment. Please don't mind the smell. Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Behind on her rent and unable to hold down a job, her friends and sister rally around to help her out. But when she's using her pee to put out cigarette fires, they may just have their work cut out for them. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/yani_neko1111)
description.ja: マナーやモラルなんて関係ねえ！クズねこの送るヤニまみれでお下品な日常をご覧ください。一応、妹とか普通にかわいいキャラもでてくるから！単行本でしか見れない貴重な喫煙シーンとかたぶん描くんで、予約してくれたらありがてーにゃ(笑)
description.es-la: Bienvenido al apartamento de Yani. Por favor, no prestes atención al olor. Yani es una chica gato con un hábito de fumar terriblemente fuerte. Cada vez que intenta dejarlo, se vuelve débil ante la ansiedad y termina cediendo casi al instante. Atrasada con la renta e incapaz de mantener un trabajo estable, sus amigos y su hermana se unen para ayudarla. Pero cuando empieza a usar su propia orina para apagar los cigarrillos, puede que realmente tengan una tarea difícil por delante. ¿Logrará algún día enderezar su vida o está condenada a vivir para siempre como una desordenada fumadora empedernida?

description.en: From Tetsuhiro Hirakawa, author of Clover and Crows Zero 2 Suzuran x Housen, comes a new story that begins in a little town in Hiroshima. Childhood friends Ren and Kiyoharu aren't just partners on the Kagura (Shinto theatrical dance) stage, they also spend their days fighting together in perfect sync. Until one day, opportunity comes knocking.

Cependant, à cause d'un mot inattendue, ils sont devenus un couple aux yeux des autres. A 18 ans, ils ont 18 ans et leur " amitié " peut-elle faire un pas de plus ?

description.en: Because Tang Chao (α) had never mentally experienced the onset of secondary sexual characteristics, she had been working as a cover model as a beta. After unexpectedly having sex with an omega, she found out that she can only be close with this omega. The next day, she met her new colleague Li Zhixu, who seems to be that omega. But... isn't this Li Zhixu a beta?
description.zh: 唐朝因为心理阴影从未经历第二性征的发作，因此她一直以贝塔的身份在做平面模特。在意外与一个欧米伽经历了甜蜜后，她发现自己能够且只能够接近这位欧米伽。第二天她发现自己的新同事李之叙，似乎正是那个她？可是……这个李之叙明明是个贝塔？

description.fr: Seung-ju est amoureux depuis longtemps de Jun-hyuk, le président du conseil étudiant. Mais un été, alors qu’il est tourmenté par cet amour impossible, quelqu’un surgit dans sa vie : Je-hyeon, le frère de Jun-hyuk. Confronté à ce nouvel intérêt pour lui, Seung-ju devra affronter ses sentiments et décider s’il pourra enfin se libérer de la fièvre de cet amour obsessionnel.

description.en: One day after summer break, the perfect young lady, Sana Tsukuyomi, showed up at school as an undead. As a school health committee member, I, Hiyoshi, ended up helping her navigate her daily life, despite her movements being as stiff as a corpse’s… A school romantic comedy featuring a heroine who’s both scary and cute!
description.ja: 完璧超人なお嬢様・月夜見紗奈が、夏休み明けのある日、アンデッドとなって登校してきた。屍体らしく身体の動きがぎこちない彼女の日常生活を、保健委員の僕こと日吉が手助けすることになったのだが……。コワくてかわいい人外ヒロインと過ごす学園ラブコメ！
description.pt-br: Um dia após as férias de verão, a jovem perfeita, Sana Tsukuyomi, apareceu na escola como uma morta-viva. Como membro do comitê de saúde da escola, eu, Hiyoshi, acabei ajudando-a a se adaptar à vida cotidiana, apesar de seus movimentos serem tão rígidos quanto os de um cadáver... Uma comédia romântica escolar com uma heroína que é ao mesmo tempo assustadora e fofa!

altTitles.ja: ぐがぐもぐるてん

description.en:
The protagonist, Gugayama Yorihime, is a girl who has just turned fifteen. She has received a divine oracle declaring that she will become "Ootsuno-sama." It sounds like a cause for celebration, yet the atmosphere in the Gugayama household as they celebrate her birthday is somehow a bit strained.

In order to carry out the ceremony for Ootsuno-sama, Yorihime is to head to Ubuzumi Shrine. It seems she will be living apart from her family for a while. On the bus bound for the shrine, other girls with horns like hers are riding along as well. Their role is to serve as attendants to Yorihime, who will become Ootsuno-sama. Although it was a lonely departure at first, life at the shrine looks like it will be lively.
description.ja:
巫女になりました。友達が８人できました――。

主人公、具我山依姫（ぐがやまよりひめ）は１５歳の誕生日を迎えたばかりの女の子。なんでも「大角様（おおつのさま）」になるという神託を受けたんだとか。めでたいことのように思われるのですが、誕生日を祝う具我山家の空気はなんだか微妙…。大角様の儀式を執り行うため、産角（うぶずみ）神社へ向かうことになった依姫。しばらくは家族の元を離れて暮らすことになるようです。神社行きのバスには、依姫のような角を生やした女の子たちが乗り合わせてきました。彼女たちの役割は、大角様になる依姫のお世話係。ひとり寂しい旅立ちでしたが、神社での生活はにぎやかになりそうです。

altTitles.en: Poppin' Poppin' Penalty

description.en:
Oden Shinonome, who became a death row inmate due to a certain crime, is sentenced to "Excavation Sentence"—a stay of execution in exchange for mining "Bogosort," a precious yet dangerous ore. Together with her fellow death row inmate, Slumber, she is taken to the Gray Mall, a mysterious and massive ruin where Bogosort is found. In this demonic realm where outlaws and dangerous creatures gather, Oden-chan's life-or-death mineral-mining days begin!

The curtain rises on a pop and thrilling prison comedy depicting the chaotic, topsy-turvy joys and sorrows of the prisoners!

description.en: Sakuya, who was raised in a church, was supposed to be living a modest but warm life alongside Sister Lamia, or that's how it should have been...! Though she tries to appear seductive, she's actually pure. Though she can be slightly dimwitted, she's adorable. Even though he tries to resist, Sakuya is continuously being led around her.
description.ja: 教会で育てられた少年・咲夜はシスター・ラミアと慎ましくも温かい暮らしをしていた――。はずだった…！エッチなふりして実はピュア、ちょっぴりアホだけど可愛いシスターに振り回されっぱなし！『いや、僕らそんなことしてる場合じゃないんだって！！！』そう…彼らには恋仲になれない理由がある。ある日　世界は崩壊してしまったから―――。

altTitles.en: Be Happy in the Real World Too, Okay?

description.en:
High school student Machino, who longs for the 'love of destiny', encounters the dating simulation game 'Celestia'. Despite having maximized affection with all the heroines, she can't decide on just one, leading her to spend days of anguish unable to advance to the confession event. At that moment, an explosion along with a shooting star occurs in her house, and when she opens her eyes, she meets the main heroine of 'Celestia', Sofia...

"Machino... I always wanted to say it... I like you."
description.id:
Machino, seorang siswa SMA yang mendambakan "cinta takdir," menemukan sebuah game simulasi kencan bernama Celestia. Meskipun sudah memaksimalkan tingkat afeksi dengan semua heroine, dia tidak bisa memutuskan hanya pada satu pilihan, membuatnya menghabiskan hari-hari penuh kegelisahan tanpa dapat melanjutkan ke acara pengakuan cinta. Pada saat itu, sebuah ledakan terjadi bersamaan dengan jatuhnya bintang di rumahnya, dan ketika dia membuka matanya, dia bertemu dengan heroine utama dari Celestia, Sofia...

"Machino... aku selalu ingin mengatakannya... Aku suka kamu."
description.ja: 恋愛シミュレーションゲーム『セレスティア』このゲームの虜になった女子高生・町乃だったが、ヒロイン全員の好感度をMAXにしたものの告白する相手を選べずにいた。そんな時、流れ星とともに自宅に爆発が起こり、目を開けるとそこにいたのは『セレスティア』のヒロイン・ソフィアだった…「……マチノ？ずっと伝えたかったの…あなたが好き」
description.vi:
Machino, một nữ sinh trung học luôn khao khát tìm kiếm “tình yêu định mệnh”, tình cờ bắt gặp trò chơi mô phỏng hẹn hò mang tên Celestia.
Dù đã đạt mức thiện cảm tối đa với tất cả các nữ chính trong game, cô lại không thể chọn chỉ một người, khiến bản thân rơi vào trạng thái dằn vặt, không thể bước tới sự kiện tỏ tình.

Đúng vào lúc ấy, một vụ nổ xảy ra cùng với sự xuất hiện của một ngôi sao băng lướt qua nhà cô. Khi tỉnh dậy, Machino đối mặt với một cảnh tượng không thể tin được, cô đang ở trước mặt Sofia, một trong những nữ chính của Celestia…
“Machino… Mình luôn muốn nói điều này… Mình thích cậu.”
description.es-la:
La estudiante de secundaria, Machino, que anhela el 'amor del destino', se encuentra con el juego de simulación de citas 'Celestia'. A pesar de haber aumentado al máximo la simpatía de todas las heroínas, no puede decidirse por una sola, lo que la lleva a pasar días de angustia sin poder avanzar al evento de confesión. En ese momento, una explosión junto con una estrella fugaz ocurre en su casa, y cuando abre los ojos, se encuentra con la heroína principal de 'Celestia', Sofía...

"Machino... siempre quise decirlo... me gustas."

¡La comedia romántica de harén de invocación a otro mundo comienza con las heroínas de alta simpatía que han saltado al mundo real!

description.en:
High school student Machino, who longs for the 'love of destiny', encounters the dating simulation game 'Celestia'. Despite having maximized affection with all the heroines, she can't decide on just one, leading her to spend days of anguish unable to advance to the confession event. At that moment, an explosion along with a shooting star occurs in her house, and when she opens her eyes, she meets the main heroine of 'Celestia', Sofia...

"Machino... I always wanted to say it... I like you."
description.id:
Machino, seorang siswa SMA yang mendambakan "cinta takdir," menemukan sebuah game simulasi kencan bernama Celestia. Meskipun sudah memaksimalkan tingkat afeksi dengan semua heroine, dia tidak bisa memutuskan hanya pada satu pilihan, membuatnya menghabiskan hari-hari penuh kegelisahan tanpa dapat melanjutkan ke acara pengakuan cinta. Pada saat itu, sebuah ledakan terjadi bersamaan dengan jatuhnya bintang di rumahnya, dan ketika dia membuka matanya, dia bertemu dengan heroine utama dari Celestia, Sofia...

"Machino... aku selalu ingin mengatakannya... Aku suka kamu."
description.ja: 恋愛シミュレーションゲーム『セレスティア』このゲームの虜になった女子高生・町乃だったが、ヒロイン全員の好感度をMAXにしたものの告白する相手を選べずにいた。そんな時、流れ星とともに自宅に爆発が起こり、目を開けるとそこにいたのは『セレスティア』のヒロイン・ソフィアだった…「……マチノ？ずっと伝えたかったの…あなたが好き」
description.vi:
Machino, một nữ sinh trung học luôn khao khát tìm kiếm “tình yêu định mệnh”, tình cờ bắt gặp trò chơi mô phỏng hẹn hò mang tên Celestia.
Dù đã đạt mức thiện cảm tối đa với tất cả các nữ chính trong game, cô lại không thể chọn chỉ một người, khiến bản thân rơi vào trạng thái dằn vặt, không thể bước tới sự kiện tỏ tình.

Đúng vào lúc ấy, một vụ nổ xảy ra cùng với sự xuất hiện của một ngôi sao băng lướt qua nhà cô. Khi tỉnh dậy, Machino đối mặt với một cảnh tượng không thể tin được, cô đang ở trước mặt Sofia, một trong những nữ chính của Celestia…
“Machino… Mình luôn muốn nói điều này… Mình thích cậu.”
description.es-la:
La estudiante de secundaria, Machino, que anhela el 'amor del destino', se encuentra con el juego de simulación de citas 'Celestia'. A pesar de haber aumentado al máximo la simpatía de todas las heroínas, no puede decidirse por una sola, lo que la lleva a pasar días de angustia sin poder avanzar al evento de confesión. En ese momento, una explosión junto con una estrella fugaz ocurre en su casa, y cuando abre los ojos, se encuentra con la heroína principal de 'Celestia', Sofía...

"Machino... siempre quise decirlo... me gustas."

¡La comedia romántica de harén de invocación a otro mundo comienza con las heroínas de alta simpatía que han saltado al mundo real!

description.en: Some 20 years have passed since the protagonist was summoned to another world and retired from the army. He is still single in his 40s and lives as a low-ranking professor, until one day, an elite "monster girl" transfers into his class.
description.ja: 異世界に召喚され、軍を退役してから約２０年。主人公は未だ独身で、もう４０代も半ば。Eランクの落ちこぼれ教師として生活するある日、彼の学園にエリートの「モンスター娘」が転校してくるのだった。
description.vi: Câu chuyện về một ông giáo trung niên (trước đây là một anh hùng) ở dị giới tình cờ gặp lại cô học trò vốn dĩ là con bạch tuộc cute phô mai que mà anh từng cứu giúp và dạy dỗ trước đây.
description.pt-br: Cerca de 20 anos se passaram desde que o protagonista foi convocado para outro mundo e se aposentou do exército. Ele ainda está solteiro na casa dos 40 anos e vive como um professor de baixo escalão, até que um dia, uma 'garota monstro' de elite é transferida para sua classe.

title.ja-ro: Akinai Ningyo to Soku no Hatsukoi

altTitles.ja: 商い人魚と蒼空の初恋

altTitles.en: The Trading Mermaid and Sora's First Love

description.en:
Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option…

One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden.
He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…?!

A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”!
description.ja:
現代を生きる人魚・沙羅（さら）は、【換金屋】として妖と人間を相手に取引をしてきた。
彼女にとって人間は、あくまで客。心を許すことなど、決してないはずだった――。

そんなある日、彼女の箱庭に迷い込んだのは、謎めいた美青年・蒼空（そら）。
敵ではなさそうだが訳アリそうな彼に、沙羅は取引を持ちかける。
しかし、蒼空が望んだ唯一の欲しい物は、まさかの沙羅本人で…！？

「取引」から始まる、恋と秘密が交錯する共同生活ラブロマンス開幕ーー！

altTitles.ja: 美味しんぼ

altTitles.en: The Gourmet

description.en:
Around the offices of Tozai News, Shiro Yamaoka has a reputation for being over-blunt, under-ambitious, and generally an all-around slacker. So why has he been given the important job of coming up with the "Ultimate Menu" to celebrate the newspaper's 100th anniversary? Because he possesses qualities his other colleagues don't: an exquisitely discerning palate, an encyclopedic knowledge of food and drink, and a masterful touch in the kitchen.

---
- **Won the Shogakukan Manga Award for Seinen/General in 1987**

description.es-la:
En un mundo donde humanos y hombres bestia conviven... Los padres de la Duquesa Eliza a menudo están ausentes por trabajo, dejándola sola en su gran mansión.
Siempre se ha sentido sola y ha pasado por momentos de soledad, pero Vincent, el caballero hombre bestia que actúa como su guardaespaldas, siempre ha estado a su lado para protegerla. Sus sentimientos por él crecen en secreto.
Un día, Eliza decide ir a la casa de Vincent, ubicada en medio del bosque. Debido al miedo de la noche oscura, le pide: "Por favor, duerme conmigo", "Yo también soy un hombre..."
Vincent se cierne sobre Eliza con una expresión seria...¡!?

description.en: Shinichi Kudo is a high school detective who sometimes works with the police to solve cases. During an investigation, he is attacked by members of a crime syndicate known as the Black Organization. They force him to ingest an experimental poison, but instead of killing him, the poison transforms him into a child. Adopting the pseudonym Conan Edogawa and keeping his true identity a secret, Kudo lives with his childhood friend Ran and her father Kogoro, who is a private detective.

This is the tale of the members of a [Beatles](https://mangadex.org/title/877aa28e-5c75-469c-84b1-4730bd321f53) cover band in Tokyo who find themselves 
transported back in time to 1961 -before anyone had ever heard of the Beatles-

description.en: Lin Jie is an otherworlder who manages a bookstore. He’s kind and always recommends soul-healing books for his dejected customers. Sometimes he’d even share his own works too. As time goes on, these customers start to respect him a lot. They bring simple local products every day to show their gratitude and ask for book recommendations. They even start telling tales of this ordinary shopkeeper. His respectful and cordial titles include “Hyena of the Evil God”, “Herald of the Flesh Gospel”, “Author of Cultes des Goules” and “Shepherd of the Stars”???
description.uk: Лінь Цзє – чужоземець з іншого світу, що став тепер звичайним власником книжкового магазину. Він доброзичливий і завжди готовий порекомендувати відвідувачам книги, що здатні зцілити їхні душі. Іноді, він ділиться і власними роботами. З часом, клієнти починають його дуже поважати. Вони щодня приносять йому маленькі сувеніри чи подарунки в знак подяки та просять у нього рекомендації щодо книги. Про цього звичайного крамаря навіть починають розповідати історії. Його з повагою та теплом звуть «Гієна Злого Бога», «Вісник Євангелія Плоті», «Автор Культу Упирів» та «Пастух Зірок».
description.zh: 穿越者林介经营着一家书店。他善良热情，总是向失意潦倒的客人们推荐治愈心灵的书籍，偶尔也会安利一下自己的拙作。久而久之，这些客人变得非常尊敬他，每天都会带来一些朴实的土特产报答他，向他请教推荐书目，并且向周边人也诉说着这个普通书店老板的事迹。他们尊敬而亲切地称呼他为——“邪神的鬣狗”、“血肉福音书的传播者”、“尸食教典仪的撰写者”、“群星的牧羊人”。“？？？”

Everyday Host Club

description.en: Salesman Sekiguchi, who works for a life insurance company, makes a rash decision and switches careers to become a host at a nightclub. At Club One, he finds himself surrounded by an eccentric cast: a "little brother" type host with 20 years of experience, a former idol who specializes in romance-driven sales, a hardcore mobile game addict with a tough-guy attitude, and more. Though Sekiguchi thinks, "This is no job for a sane person." He uses his insurance sales skills to attract customers, plunging headfirst into a wild and outrageous host life.
description.ja: 生命保険会社の営業・関口は病んだ勢いでホストクラブへ転職してしまう。ホスト歴“20年”の弟系ホスト、元アイドルの色恋営業ホスト、ソシャゲ狂いのオラオラ系ホストなどなど「クラブ・ワン」のホストは個性的すぎる面々。関口は「まともな頭で続く職業じゃない」思いつつも保険営業のスキルを発揮して客を獲得。とんでもないホスト生活をおくることになる。

altTitles.en: I Don't Want to Play Matchmaker!
I Don't Want to Be an Ojakgyo
I Don't Want to Be the Magpie Bridge
I Don't Want to Be a Magpie Bridge

description.en:
I’ve been reincarnated into a side character of a novel. On top of that, I am the character who is like a magpie bridge in the mentally-exhausting story, *The Guys Around Hestia*.

There is no romance in store for me, and it absolutely horrifies me to think that my family is destined to drown in debt!

I planned on becoming a civil servant, enjoying a life of wealth and honor that I was unable to attain in my previous life but… why are the guys behaving out of character? Why are you blushing in front of me? Why do you keep giving me food?

“Can you Imagine Shushu being shy when looking at someone?”

“Whoa… It’d be amazing if that happens.”

As Cory absent-mindedly said that to Hiley, Eve frowned and murmured under his breath, “Should I run away with her…”

Swan remained silent while he hid his face with his sleeves. His face and ears turned red.

What’s up with you guys? Why are you guys doing other things instead of being obsessed with the female lead? Get yourself together!

This is the survival story of an academy student, Schulaina West, who wants to pursue a wealthy future in a reverse harem novel. 

TL/N: Magpie Bridge is the bridge made by a flock of magpies that connects the two star-crossed lovers Orihime and Hikoboshi in the legend behind the Tanabata festival.

Eating school lunches, having likes and dislikes, and forgetting things as elementary school students do. Casually hanging out whilst their parents get along, as next-door neighbors do.
description.ja: 小学６年生・八乙女カイ。彼のマンションの隣に引っ越してきたのは、少し変わった女の子！？小学生だから、給食食べたり、好き嫌いがあったり、忘れ物したり…だって小学生だもの。お隣さんだから、気軽に遊びに行ったり、親同士も仲良くなったり…だってお隣さんだから。

description.en: Yamamoto and Wada are two childhood friends attending different high schools who convene every afternoon at the food court at their local mall to engage in blissfully mundane conversations.
description.ja: 一見優等生で深窓の令嬢、話しかけ難い雰囲気を醸し出す和田。 金髪に日焼けした肌、ギャルのような見た目で周りから怖がられる山本。 それぞれ違う学校に通い、ひとりきりで過ごす二人。 そんな二人が毎日の放課後、フードコートで出会う時だけは、お互いしか知らない表情を見せるのです。

Yamamoto y Wada son dos amigas de la infancia que atienden diferentes escuelas preparatorias y que se reúnen todas las tardes en la plaza de comidas del centro comercial local para tener charlas encantadoramente mundanas.

title.en: Duck Leeks are Poisonous: Professor Kamo's Lecture on Human Economics

altTitles.ja: カモのネギには毒がある　加茂教授の人間経済学講義

altTitles.ja-ro: Kamo no Negi ni wa Doku ga Aru - Kamo Kyouju no "Ningen" Keizaigaku Kougi

description.en:
"Hey, are you a sucker?"

Kamo Youhei is a genius economist whose "Suckerism Economic Theory" has gained worldwide acclaim. He is a "weirdo" who pretends to be many things under the guise of "fieldwork," but in a society where the economically weak are exploited and cheated, he puts his economic theories into practice and feeds poison to the crooked and powerful!
description.ja: そこのアナタ、カモられてませんか――？「カモリズム経済理論」が世界的に評価されている天才経済学者・加茂洋平。“フィールドワーク”と称して様々な姿に成りすます「変人」だが、経済弱者が搾取され、騙される社会で、自らの経済理論を実践し、ペテン強者たちに毒を喰らわせる――！！

Journal with Witch

altTitles.ja: 違国日記

altTitles.es-la: Diario en otro pais

description.en: Makio Kodai (35), a novelist, cannot bear to see her niece Asa (15) being passed around by relatives at the funeral of her sister and her husband, and decides to take her in on the spur of the moment. However, although she took her niece home, she came to her senses the next day and her natural shyness kicked in. Makio had forgotten how unsuitable she was to live with someone. Asa, on the other hand, is not shy and agrees to live with Maki, an "adult who is not like an adult," in an unusual but honest way. This is the story of when two polar opposite worlds awkwardly try to interact.
description.es: La vida diaria de una huérfana de 15 años y su (hasta ahora) distanciada tía, la novelista de 35 años con la que termina viviendo, y lo que sucede cuando dos polos opuestos tratan de interactuar -embarazosamente-.
description.vi: Tiểu thuyết gia Koudai Makio (35 tuổi), trong đám tang của vợ chồng chị gái, không đành lòng khi thấy người cháu mồ côi của mình - Asa (15 tuổi), bị đùn đẩy bởi họ hàng, đã nhận nuôi cô bé trong phút bốc đồng. Ngày hôm sau, khi đã định thần lại, bản tính ngại người lạ của cô bộc phát. Makio đã quên rằng tính cách của mình không hợp để sống cùng người khác. Ngược lại, Asa chẳng hề ngại ngùng, đã chấp nhận một cách kỳ lạ và chân thành, sống chung với Makio, một "người lớn chẳng ra dáng người lớn". Một câu chuyện về người cô lóng ngóng và cô cháu gái cún con, 2 thế hệ cách biệt, chung sống dưới một mái nhà.

altTitles.ja: 最弱と呼ばれた剣闘士のゲーム知識無双 一女尊男卑世界のコロ シアムで成り上がるー

description.en:
Taiki is a heavy spender who lives for his favorite character.
No matter how many times he pulls the gacha, his favorite never shows up…

Just as his funds are about to run out and he thinks, “This is my last try…,” Taiki suddenly reincarnates into the world of the game he poured his heart and soul into: “Arcana Campus.”

He thought he’d be able to build a harem of female characters like angels and elves…
But instead, it turns out to be a dangerous world with extreme female supremacy and male inferiority!

Will Taiki be able to survive in this world…!?
description.id:
Taiki adalah seorang “whale” (pemain yang rela menghabiskan banyak uang) yang hidup demi karakter favoritnya.
Namun, seberapa pun banyak ia menarik gacha, karakter kesayangannya tak kunjung muncul…
Saat dananya hampir habis dan ia berpikir “ini yang terakhir…”, tiba-tiba Taiki bereinkarnasi ke dalam dunia game yang selama ini ia curahkan seluruh jiwa dan raganya: “Arcana Campus.”
Ia sempat berharap bisa membangun harem berisi karakter perempuan seperti malaikat dan elf…
Tapi ternyata dunia itu adalah tempat berbahaya dengan sistem wanita di atas pria yang sangat ekstrem!
Akankah Taiki bisa bertahan hidup dengan selamat…!?

Deep in the forest where ferocious beasts and magical creatures dwell, a cat takes in an orphaned baby dragon as one of her own.
___
**Character Designer:** [Ookuma Mai](https://mangadex.org/author/cddeb48b-eb1d-4ccc-bbea-7a0dafc9e4c9)
description.ja: 「なぁ、羽のおじちゃん。おいら人間の子供に、魔法を教えてやりたいんだ」。深い深い森の奥。一匹の火吹き竜が、魔法を操る猫たちと暮らしていた。竜は、この森で猫に育てられたのだ。竜の寿命は永い。兄弟猫はとっくに眠りに就き、その子猫が育ち、また新たな命が生まれる。長きにわたり森の猫を守り育てる人間嫌いの竜を、猫たちは「羽のおじちゃん」と呼び、人間は畏怖と敬意を込めて「猫竜」と呼んだ。森の猫は大きくなると、縄張りを求めて巣立っていく。その中には、人間と暮らす猫もいるのだ。冒険の旅に出た王子と、師匠の黒猫。孤児院に住むものぐさ少女と、少女に魔法を教える白猫。冒険者ギルドの看板猫になったのもいる。そして森では、今日も竜が子猫に狩りを教えている。これは、猫と竜と人間の、温かくて不思議な物語。

description.en:
After being defeated and captured, the dragon slayer Leon became a captive of the Silver Dragon Queen. With the awareness of death, he used forbidden magic to curse the queen, but unexpectedly, the queen lost control. 

He thought that this would make the queen live with shame for the rest of her life, and it would be worthy of the dragon slayer's mission. 

But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, next to him was a little dragon girl with a tail...
description.id: Setelah dikalahkan dan ditangkap, Dragon Slayer Leon menjadi tawanan Silver Dragon Queen. Dengan kesadaran akan kematian, dia menggunakan sihir terlarang untuk mengutuk sang ratu, tetapi secara tak terduga, sang ratu kehilangan kendali. Dia berpikir bahwa ini akan membuat sang ratu hidup dalam rasa malu seumur hidupnya, dan itu akan sepadan dengan misinya sebagai pemburu naga. Namun, dua tahun kemudian, ketika Leon membuka matanya, di sampingnya ada seorang gadis kecil naga dengan ekor...
description.uk:
Після поразки та полону, вбивця драконів Леон потрапив у полон до королеви клану Срібних Драконів. Усвідомлюючи наближення смерті, він використав заборонену техніку, щоб накласти прокляття на королеву, але несподівано королева втратила контроль.

Він думав, що це змусить королеву жити з соромом до кінця життя, і це буде гідно титулу вбивці драконів.

Але через два роки, коли Леон розплющив очі, поруч з ним сиділа дівчинка-дракон із хвостиком...

description.en: His grades are average. His physical fitness is average. But when it comes to games, high school student Mikagami​ Kouji is a battle-worn veteran. After being summoned to another world by a magic circle, he's given only the Copy skill, which is derided as useless trash in this world. Enslaved as a gladiator by his summoner, Head Priestess Zayd, Mikagami is forced to fight in the horrible Battle Coliseum. Losing means getting raped. In this moment, as despair turns to hope, this is Mikagami's chance to grow!!
description.es:
Koji Mikagami, es un estudiante mediocre y su forma física es regular. Sin embargo, cuando se trata de videojuegos, resulta que es un gamer compulsivo.
Fue invocado a otro mundo y la habilidad que obtuvo fue "Copiar", que en ese mundo es una habilidad inútil.
Debido a eso, es esclavizado como gladiador por su invocadora la tetona Sacerdotisa Zayd, donde se dice que será violado si pierde, Mikagami es atormentado por el miedo y la desesperación, pero en el proceso, se da cuenta de algo que hace su desesperación se convierte en esperanza, y el Coliseo se convierta en el único escenario de Mikagami.
description.id: Siswa sekolah menengah Kouji Mikagami, memiliki nilai pelajaran biasa dan kemampuan atletik biasa, tapi "dia tidak banyak kalah" dalam bermain game, entah kenapa saat bermain game dia tiba-tiba dipanggil ke dunia lain. Sebuah cerita yang dimulai dengan apa yang terjadi. Meskipun mengkonsumsi 1.000 batu ajaib tingkat tinggi untuk melakukan pemanggilan, fakta bahwa ia hanya memiliki "Skill Copy" kemampuan terlemah membuat marah pendeta, dan akhirnya Mikagami dijadikan budak gladiator di Colosseum. Mikagami yang kesal dengan situasi yang tiba-tiba menyadari bahwa situasinya seperti dalam game, dan dengan kemampuan terlemahnya dia akan membuat budak harem di dunia lain.

description.en:
Hayden, who wants to hide that he is Alpha, is offered to help with his assignment one day by another Alpha, Brett. Brett, however, is an Alpha who doesn't hide his pheromones at all. Of course, while the uncomfortable encounters continued due to the incompatibility of personalities, Hayden became angry to hear that Brett had touched his best friend who is an Omega.

"Accept what I want to trample on you and humiliate you. It's instinct, as you say."
description.ko:
자신이 알파라는 것을 숨기고 싶어하는 헤이든은, 어느날 또다른 알파 브렛에게 자신의 과제를 도와달라는 제안을 받는다. 하지만 브렛은 자신의 페로몬을 전혀 감추지 않는 알파. 당연하게도 성격이 맞지 않아 불편한 만남이 계속되던 와중, 그가 자신의 가장 친한 친구인 오메가를 건드렸다는 얘길 듣고 분노하고 마는데...

"내가 너를 짓밟고 굴욕을 주고 싶은 것도 받아들여. 네 말대로 이건 본능이니까."
description.es-la: Hayden,  quiere ocultar que es un Alfa, se ofrece un día para ayudar con su tarea a otro Alfa, Brett. Brett, sin embargo, es un Alfa que no oculta sus feromonas en lo absoluto.  Mientras continuaban los incómodos encuentros por la incompatibilidad de personalidades, Hayden se enfadó al escuchar que Brett había tocado a su mejor amigo que es un Omega. “Acepta como te pisotearé y te humillaré. Es solo instinto, justo como tú  me lo dijiste."

description.en:
A confusion made in childhood leads to a surprising yet beautiful relationship in this sweet romance manga.

Shuichi and Yuika have been close friends since they were kids. But Shuichi had always thought Yuika was a boy, so their reunion 10 years ago was filled with surprise when Yuika had seemingly transformed into a beautiful young woman! Intimidated by his friend’s beauty, Shuichi was sure this would be the end of their friendship. And it was… because the two traded in friendship for marriage! 

A sweet and charming love story about finding friendship and love with your person.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
description.fr:
Shuichi est un lycéen, qui a fini par épouser son amie d'enfance qu'il croyait être un garçon.
C'est au cours de leur retrouvaille dix années plus tard, que cette fameuse amie prénommé Yuika s'est transformée en une ravissante femme, ce qui a d'abord rendu Shuichi assez nerveux. Cependant, au fil du temps, il s'est progressivement habitué au sentiment de proximité des meilleurs amis, et c'est ainsi que débute leur histoire d'amour en tant que couple idéal avec une charmante touche d'innocence !
description.ja:
親友だから、通じ合えちゃう。

高校生の秀一は、男だと思っていた幼馴染の唯華といきなり結婚することになってしまう。10年ぶりの再会に、最初はぎこちなかったが徐々に昔を思い出して――。楽しい高校生活と新婚生活を満喫しちゃう!?

意識しあっても、あと一歩が踏み出せない。
description.pt-br: Shuichi, um estudante do ensino médio, acabou se casando com seu amigo de infância que ele pensava ser um menino. Em seu reencontro após 10 anos, sua amiga de infância Yuika se transformou em uma linda garota, o que inicialmente deixou Shuichi bastante nervoso. No entanto, com o passar do tempo, ele gradualmente se acostumou com a sensação de proximidade como melhores amigos - e assim começa a história de amor deles como um casal ideal com um toque encantador de inocência!

description.en:
After a traffic accident, 52-year-old civil servant Kenzaburou Tondabayashi awakens to find he's become Grace Auvergne, a duke's daughter, and more importantly the villainess of an otome game. Not wanting to get in the way of the happy endings of the young characters around him, Grace sets out to play the role of the villain, but whether it's due to Kenzaburou's memories of being an affectionate parent getting in the way or not being able to remember those pesky foreign names properly, it ends up being a lot harder than it looks…
___
**Official English:** [emaqi](https://emaqi.com/manga/from-bureaucrat-to-villainess-dad-s-been-reincarnated) - United States & Canada only.
description.id:
Setelah mengalami sebuah kecelakaan, seorang PNS berusia 52 tahun bernama kenzaburou tondabayashi tiba-tiba berada di tubuh seorang putri duke yang bernama grace auvergne, terlebih lagi, grace merupakan seorang villainess di sebuah game otome. Tidak ingin mengganggu happy ending anak-anak muda yang ada di dekatnya, grace memutuskan untuk menjalankan perannya sebagai seorang villainess, tapi mungkin karena ingatan kenzaburou yang dulunya merupakan seorang orang tua yang penuh kasih sayang atau karena tidak bisa mengingat nama-nama asing, akhirnya setiap grace ingin menjalankan peran villainessnya, grace selalu terganggu.
Sehingga dia merasa menjadi seorang villainess ternyata lebih sulit dari yang dia pikirkan...
description.ja: ５２歳の真面目な公務員・屯田林憲三郎は交通事故に遭う。気が付いたらそこは学園舞台の乙女ゲームのような世界…しかも校内一高飛車なオーヴェルヌ侯爵家の令嬢グレイスに転生してしまい！？
description.es-la: Tras perder el conocimiento, después de realizar un acto heroico, el oficinista de 52 años, Kenzaburou Tondabayashi, despertó como Grace Auvergne, la hija de un duque perteneciente a un juego Otome y a su vez la villana de la historia. En un afán de querer cumplir su rol como villana para no afectar la historia del mundo, verá cómo su carácter de padre amoroso y de persona amable harán que su objetivo sea más difícil de lo que esperaba...

altTitles.ja: キリングバイツ

description.en: People have been created that are human-animal hybrids, and powerful businesses bet on the outcome of their duels. College student Nomoto Yuuya's casual acquaintances ask him to drive them around to pick up girls one day, which he soon finds out means by force. The girl they kidnap is an animal-human hybrid named Hitomi, who slaughters all of them except Yuuya. Hitomi is a honey badger, which has been called the most fearless of all animals. Now Hitomi is assigned to stay with Yuuya, for his protection! Killing Bites are underworld duels between human-animal hybrids. One beast who knows no fear will fight in this animalistic world full of fear and insanity.
description.ja: 冴えない青年・野本は、謎の少女・瞳と出会い、とある廃棄場へと連れてこられる。行き場のないモノが集められたそこでは、人の頭脳と獣の力を併せ持つ「獣人」達による、凄惨な賭け試合が行われていた――。ぶつかり合う牙と牙、剥き出された野性、渦巻く欲望と狂気。その戦いの名は「牙闘(キリングバイツ)」――！！
description.ru:
Один учёный создал существ которые являются гибридом человека и животного, и богачи ставят ставки на исход их поединков. Случайные знакомые просят студента колледжа Номота Юя покатать их по городу, и ближе к вечеру он узнает, что они просто хотели подобрать и изнасиловать девушку. Девушка, которую они похищают оказывается “гибридом” которую зовут Хитоми, которая убивает всех кроме Юи. Хитоми является гибридом барсука, который был назван самым бесстрашным из всех животных. Теперь Хитоми остаётся с Юи, для его защиты!

description.pt-br: Pessoas estão sendo criadas como híbridos animal-humano e batalham entre si, empresas poderosas apostam no resultado de seus duelos. A história inicia com um cara que se meteu no rapto de uma garota contra a sua vontade, todos menos ele acabam mortos pela garota, que ele descobre ser um dos híbridos, competindo com outros de sua raça em duelos mortais envolvendo complexas apostas. Sem aviso prévio, ele acaba obrigado a se tornar o parceiro da garota.

description.en:
The strongest doesn’t need any cheats! Haruka, who spends his high school life a loner, was suddenly summoned to another world one day along with all his classmates. When ol’ God enters the picture, Haruka believes he can just choose whatever cheat skill he wants to help him survive in the new world… But, contrary to his expectations, that list of cheat skills works on a first come, first serve basis. And so, his classmates pick out all the cheat skills. His choices now limited to leftovers, Haruka finds himself incapable of assembling a party due to his own “loner” skill. Even though it’s a different world, it seems his adventuring days will be, as per usual, a solitary affair… After becoming aware of a crisis looming over his classmates, Haruka makes a silent vow to save them. No relying on cheats! He will walk a heretical path of strength that transcends the need for them.  
  
The curtain rises on the strongest loner’s otherworld strategy guide!
description.vi: Câu chuyện theo chân Haruka - một cậu học sinh trung học mọt sách cô độc, đột nhiên bị triệu hồi đến dị giới với đám bạn học. Không giống như cả lớp nhận được các kỹ năng cheat đủ để làm bá chủ tại thế giới khác, nhân vật chính của chúng ta phải ôm theo bảng trạng thái phế vật mà lăn lộn hòng sống sót. Vậy thì, hãy cùng dõi theo và cổ vũ cho Haruka có thể tai qua nạn khỏi, vươn đến đỉnh cao mà không cần tới cheat trong câu chuyện tràn đầy hài hước này nhé.
description.es-la: El fuerte no necesita trucos. Haruka, un estudiante de preparatoria quien gastó su vida como un "solitario", es convocado a otro mundo con sus compañeros de clases. Al ser convocado se encuentra con un "Dios", quien le da a escoger una habilidad, sin embargo... No era lo que esperaba encontrarse.
description.pt-br:
Exilado da classe? Checado  
  
Ser transportado para um mundo alternativo com seus colegas? Checado  
  
 Encontrar um Deus em uma espécie de Limbo entre os dois mundos? Checado  
  
 Pegar uma skill roubada? Não gostaria de ser você, já foram todas vendidas.  
  
 Essa história é sobre a aventura de um garoto solitário em um mundo alternativo, não agradecido a um Deus sênil que deu a ele todas as habilidades que não precisava.

title.ja-ro: Nee-chan no Tomodachi ga Uzai Hanashi

altTitles.ja: 姉ちゃんの友達がうざい話

altTitles.en: My Older Sister's Friend Is Annoying

altTitles.vi: Bạn thân của chị gái tôi thật phiền phức

description.en:
High school freshman Nao Misumi has known Sena Ikuta, his older sister Rio’s best friend, since he was in elementary school. As a self-proclaimed “sister’s boy”, Nao has always found Sena’s over-familiarity incredibly annoying. Yet, despite being loud, airheaded, and having zero sense of personal space, he could never truly bring himself to hate her. She has always looked out for him just as much as she has for Rio. 

She’s a total idiot, too carefree, and her sense of personal space is completely broken. To Nao, she’s supposed to be nothing more than a nuisance, and yet... 

“At first, I hated her for sure. She was noisy, and always took the things I cherished. So why is it that now—?” 

Even as he grumbles about her constantly calling him “Lil bro," he finds himself unable to leave her alone. How did this “annoying” fixture in his life become the one person he can’t look away from?
description.ja: 高校1年生の三澄尚は、姉の莉緒の親友・生田瀬那と小学生の頃からの知り合い。弟呼びする瀬那を鬱陶しく感じながらも、ほっとけない存在で…？
description.vi:
Nao Misumi, học sinh năm nhất cấp ba, đã quen biết Sena Ikuta, cô bạn thân của chị gái mình là Rio, từ hồi còn học tiểu học.

Là một người tự nhận mình là "cuồng chị gái", Nao luôn thấy cực kỳ khó chịu trước sự thân thiết quá mức của Sena. Thế nhưng, dù cô lúc nào cũng ồn ào, hậu đậu và hoàn toàn không biết giữ khoảng cách với người khác, cậu lại chẳng thể nào thật sự ghét nổi cô.

Bởi Sena luôn quan tâm đến cậu chẳng kém gì Rio.

Cô ấy đúng là một tên ngốc. Vô tư quá mức. Mà ý thức về khoảng cách cá nhân thì gần như bằng không.

Đối với Nao, đáng lẽ cô chỉ nên là một kẻ phiền phức mà thôi.

Vậy mà...

"Lúc đầu mình ghét cô ấy thật. Cô ấy lúc nào cũng ồn ào, lại còn luôn lấy mất những thứ mình trân quý. Vậy mà tại sao bây giờ..."

Dù lúc nào cũng càm ràm chuyện Sena cứ gọi mình là "em trai", Nao lại chẳng thể mặc kệ cô được.

Rốt cuộc từ khi nào "kẻ phiền phức" luôn hiện diện trong cuộc sống của cậu...

...lại trở thành người duy nhất khiến cậu không thể rời mắt?

altTitles.ja: ボクガール

description.en:
Mizuki gets confessed to by a boy in front of a special mirror. Legend has it, that if you confess to someone you like in front of that mirror your wish comes true.  
  
There is a slight problem in this equation: Mizuki is just a very feminine looking boy.  
  
Also, it seems that he caught the attention of the Norse Trickster God, Loki, while glancing into the mirror. Loki decides out of boredom to mess with Mizuki and turns him into a real girl.
description.fr: Suzushiro Mizuki est un lycéen en 1e année victime de quelques difficultés dans sa vie : en effet, les gens le confondent constamment avec une fille ! Les garçons qui l’entoure finisse toujours par lui déclarer leur flamme. Même la fille qu’il aime le voit plus comme une amie que comme un potentiel petit ami. Et pour couronner le tout, Loki, déesse des farces fatiguée d’embêter les dieux, décide de se tourner vers le monde des humains, faisant de Suzushiro sa cible. Résultat : Mizuki se réveille dans un corps amputé de la seule réelle preuve de sa masculinité. Comment va-t-il réussir à gérer tout ça ?
description.pl:
Suzushiro Mizuki, chłopak o bardzo niewieściej urodzie, każdego dnia wychodzi z siebie, aby ludzie nie mylili go z dziewczyną. Jego starania nie przynoszą rezulatatów, a po tym gdy przez lustro w ścianie, zauważa go nordyca bogini Loki, która postanawia się nieco zabawić kosztem nieszczęśnika, zamieniając go w dziewczynę, sprawy przybierają jeszcze bardziej szaleńczy obrót. Teraz będzie musiał stawić czoła poważnym problemom – bo co zrobić, gdy, miłość głównego bohatera zaczyna traktować go jak najlepszą przyjaciółę, a przyjaciel z dzieciństwa zaczyna czuć miętę do przemienionego chłopaka?

description.en:
"I will become a hero!"

With that dream in her heart, Shirumiruku Eru became an adventurer. But because she had no special skills, she struggled to find companions. That's when she got the chance to join the dungeon investigation led by Yuris, a great sage who specializes in healing. However, rumor has it that all adventurers who accompanied Yuris have had their spirits broken and abandoned their path as adventurers halfway through... You see, Yuris had a bizarre interest in getting excited by the sight of female adventurers being attacked by monsters.
description.ja: 英雄になる！そんな想いを胸に冒険者になったシルミルク。スキルをもたない彼女は仲間集めに苦労していた。そんな時、回復のエキスパートである大賢者ユーリスのダンジョン調査に同行することになる。しかし噂ではユーリスに同行した冒険者は皆一様に心をやられ、冒険者としての道を志半ばに絶ってしまうそうな……。そう、ユーリスにはモンスターにやられる女冒険者の姿に興奮するという猟奇的な趣向があったのである。

description.en: Having met an unfortunate end, Misaki is reincarnated as an extraordinary mandrake that transforms into a deadly monster just by screaming! Determined to finally enjoy a happy (human?) life, she manages to take on a human form, but her inability to speak causes all sorts of misunderstandings, leading people to worship her as the "Flower Witch"... While dreading being hunted if her true nature is revealed, she struggles to achieve a peaceful life!!

description.en:
Minori is the only daughter of the Sano family, a family that is the picture of happiness. 

One day, Minori returns home after cheerfully forgetting something as usual, and encounters a burglar who has been breaking into the house. She falls from the balcony, and to her surprise, she and the thief switch bodies!

Until they get each other's bodies back, they begin a strange four-person life: father, mother, daughter, and thief.

A disturbing, heartwarming comedy begins!

description.en: Fumi Isshiki works as an accountant at an entertainment agency. One day he is transferred to the management department, where Ayano Haga, a 13-year-old child actress, seems to take a liking to him... She is just a child, yet she acts more mature than many adults.
description.ja: 芸能事務所で経理として働く一色文は、ある日営業へと部署異動を言い渡される。担当するまだ１３歳の子役の少女、羽賀文乃は、妙に文のことを気に入ったようで…？
description.vi:
Isshiki Fumi là nhân viên kế toán của một công ty giải trí. Một ngày nọ, anh được thuyên chuyển sang phòng kinh doanh - bộ phận quản lý các tài năng. Đối tượng quản lý của anh là một đứa trẻ 13 tuổi, Haga Ayano, một nữ diễn viên nhí…?

Một câu chuyện hồi hộp về một nữ diễn viên nhí chuyên nghiệp với cách hành xử trưởng thành hơn cả người lớn, và quản lý của cô bé.
description.es-la: Isshiki Fumi trabaja como contador en una agencia de entretenimiento. Un día es transferido al departamento de operaciones, donde Haga Ayano, una actriz de 13 años, ¿parece simpatizar con él...? Ella es sólo una niña, pero actúa con más madurez que la mayoría de los adultos. ¡Una dramática historia entre una actriz infantil profesional y su representante!

description.en:
Haruna, a magical girl who fought to protect everyone’s smiles, is suddenly transported to a parallel world where “Magical Girls” do not exist.

As the Demon King shows signs of resurrection and magical beasts ravage the land, Haruna takes a stand against the darkness threatening this new world.

No matter how badly wounded or bloodied she becomes, Haruna keeps smiling as she fights—slowly carving the name of the “Magical Girl” into the history of another world.
description.ja: 魔法少女として人々の笑顔を守るため悪と戦っていた少女ハルナは、ある日謎の魔法陣により、魔法少女の概念がない異世界へ転移してしまう。魔王復活の兆しにより、各地に魔獣が大量に溢れるこの異世界でも人々の笑顔が奪われていると知ったハルナは、村を滅ぼそうとしていた大量の魔獣相手に一人で立ち向かっていく。どんなに傷だらけになっても、勇者と敵対しても、周りに恐れられても、笑顔を絶やさず魔法少女の信念を貫き続ける彼女に、世界は希望と戦慄を覚えていきーー。
description.ru: Цель волшебницы Харуны — во что бы ни стало защитить улыбки людей, именно поэтому она сражается со злом. Однажды таинственный магический круг переносит её в незнакомый мир: в нём нет других волшебниц, а вот демонов много — кажется, их Владыка, некогда побеждённый славным героем, может возродиться… Осознав, что и здесь зло лишает людей улыбок, Харуна решает стать защитницей этого мира.
description.pt-br:
Haruna é uma garota mágica que dedica sua vida a lutar contra o mal para proteger o sorriso de todos. Porém, sua jornada toma um rumo inesperado quando um círculo mágico misterioso a transporta para um mundo paralelo completamente desconhecido.

Nesta nova terra, o conceito de "Garota Mágica" é inexistente. O Rei Demônio, que há muito tempo foi selado por um herói lendário, está prestes a ressurgir, trazendo consigo hordas implacáveis de bestas mágicas que assolam os continentes.

Ao perceber que, mesmo neste mundo, o mal continua roubando a felicidade das pessoas, Haruna decide agir. Sozinha, ela encara um exército de monstros para salvar um vilarejo da aniquilação total. Coberta de sangue e sem se importar com seus próprios ferimentos, ela mantém um sorriso constante enquanto extermina as trevas. É o início de uma nova lenda: o nome da "Garota Mágica" começa a ser escrito a sangue na história deste mundo.

Welcome Home To The Horizon

description.en:
Ryouma runs a public bathhouse with his grandfather in a seaside town. One day, during his usual routine of running the bathhouse after school, a boy named Reo appears, claiming to be his father's illegitimate son.

(MANGA Plus)
description.ja: 「だって俺ら子供やし　誰も悪くないやん」　海辺の街で、祖父と銭湯を営む遼馬。いつものように学校帰りに開店準備をしていると、父の隠し子を名乗る玲臣という少年がやって来て――？
description.pt-br:
Ryouma administra uma casa de banho pública com seu avô em uma cidade litorânea. Certo dia, durante sua rotina habitual de cuidar do estabelecimento após a escola, surge um garoto chamado Reo, afirmando ser filho ilegítimo de seu pai.

(MANGA Plus)

description.fr:
Bienvenue au Cirque ! Un refuge itinérant pour tous les fugueurs, où personne ne demande pourquoi vous êtes parti ni où vous allez. À vrai dire, ils ne le savent pas eux-mêmes.
David — danseur de poi débutant et nouveau membre de la troupe — vient de quitter la maison pour partir à la découverte du monde et se trouver lui-même. Concentré sur son objectif de devenir un véritable artiste, il finira par trouver autre chose en chemin. Au milieu de la fumée et des flammes, il commence à entrevoir une part de lui-même qu’il ne peut plus ignorer.

description.en:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job: a gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life. Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are seeking a large sum of money for some reason. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.
___
This work may affect you physically and mentally. Read it at your own risk. We are not responsible for any damage to your health.
description.ja: 裏バイト。それは合法違法含むグレーゾーンの高額報酬アルバイト。その金は、あなたの命の値段。とある事情で大金を求める黒嶺ユメと白浜和美の2人は、軽い気持ちで裏バイトに手を染めていく――。

description.en: In a world where people suddenly develop super-powers, those who use their abilities to do evil are held at Catastrophe Prison. Shu Ono, a guard at the prison, somehow falls in love with the strongest female prisoner, Lava! A crazy love-comedy about the forbidden relationship between guard and prisoner!
description.es-la: Un mundo en el que las personas desarrollan repentinamente habilidades diferentes. Los que utilizan sus habilidades para hacer el mal son encarcelados en una prisión de catastrófica. Shu Ono, que trabaja allí como guardia, se enamora de algún modo de la prisionera más fuerte, ¡Lava!

altTitles.ja: レプリカだって、恋をする。

altTitles.en: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love

altTitles.vi: Kể Cả Bản Sao Cũng Biết Yêu

altTitles.es-la: Las réplicas también se enamoran

description.en:
On days when she is sick, on days when she has a tedious day job, on days when she has regular tests.

On days when she is too lazy to go to school, I am called upon.
I am a convenient substitute for the body of a girl named Sunao Aikawa, and that is me.
I may look exactly the same, but my personality is a little different.
I can't go out freely, I can't even make plans for tomorrow,
I am a replica whose mission is to work for the original.
I was supposed to be a replica, but I fell in love.

A very pure and slightly mysterious "love story" that takes place in a town by the sea.

---
Alt. Official English: [Yen Press](https://yenpress.com/series/even-a-replica-can-fall-in-love-manga)
description.ru:
В дни, когда она болеет, в дни, когда у нее нудная дневная работа, в дни, когда у нее очередные контрольные.

В дни, когда ей лень идти в школу, обращаются ко мне.
Я - удобный заменитель тела девушки по имени Сунао Аикава, и это я.
Может, я и выгляжу точно так же, но характер у меня немного другой.
Я не могу свободно выходить на улицу, не могу даже строить планы на завтра,
Я - копия, чья миссия - работать на оригинал.
Я должна была стать копией, но я влюбилась.

Очень красивая и немного загадочная "история любви", которая происходит в городке на берегу моря.
description.vi:
Vào những ngày mà cô ấy bị cảm, vào những ngày mà cô ấy có một công việc tẻ nhạt, vào những ngày mà cô ấy có bài kiểm tra thường xuyên.

Vào những ngày mà cô ấy quá lười để đi học, tôi được gọi ra.
Tôi là vật thay thế cho cơ thể của một cô gái tên là Sunao Aikawa, và đó chính là tôi.
Tôi có lẽ trông giống hệt họ, nhưng mà tính cách của tôi thì có hơi khác một chút.
Tôi không thể tự do ra ngoài được, tôi cũng chẳng thể nào lên kế hoạch cho ngày mai.
Tôi chỉ được coi là một bản sao thôi, nhưng tôi đã biết yêu.

Một "chuyện tình" rất trong sáng và có chút bí ẩn diễn ra tại một thị trấn ven biển.
description.es-la:
En los días en que se siente enferma, en los días en que tiene la trabajosa tarea de ser responsable del turno, en los días de exámenes regulares...
 
Cuando ella no tiene ganas de ir a la escuela, me llaman a mí. Soy el duplicado de Sunao Aikawa, una niña llamada Sonao, un sustituto conveniente. 

Aunque nuestra apariencia es completamente idéntica, nuestras personalidades son un poco diferentes. No puedo salir libremente ni planificar mis propios planes para el día siguiente. Soy una réplica cuyo propósito es trabajar en beneficio del original. Eso es lo que se suponía que era, pero me enamoré.

description.en: Uesugi-kun is a boy who's as petite and cute as a girl. He has a crush on a girl he's known since childhood, but overheard her saying, "Wouldn't Uesugi be totally adorable if he was a girl?!" Uesugi-kun's not as tall as his other childhood friend, Eito, nor is he as good at studies, and now he's suffering from a broken heart. A depressed Uesugi-kun stops by a shrine while running an errand and makes a wish...
description.ja:
可愛すぎる女体化男子の恋の行方は――！？

上杉ケースケの悩みは男子なのに小さくて可愛いこと。ある日、片想いの相手・のえるが「上杉が女の子だったらめっちゃ可愛くない!？」と話しているのを聞いてしまう。

「オレ、男扱いもされてないってこと…!？」

幼なじみで何でもできる瑛人には、身長も勉強も勝てないし、失恋もしちゃうし…。落ち込むケースケが、家の隣の神社で恋がかなうようにお願いをしてみると、身体が女の子になっちゃって――!?
description.pt-br: Uesugi-kun é um garoto tão pequeno e fofo quanto uma garota. Uesugi-kun não é tão alto quanto seu outro amigo de infância, Eito, nem tão bom nos estudos, e agora está sofrendo por um coração partido. Uesugi-kun, deprimido, para em um santuário e faz um pedido...

description.en:
The Fors family is a prestigious lineage of swordsmen and a prominent noble house ruling the southern domain of the kingdom. Born as their third son, Nova endured a harsh childhood, branded a failure due to his utter inability to wield the exclusive power inherent to their bloodline. Even after reaching adulthood and being granted a small territory, he is burdened with virtually zero duties and zero expectations from his family and the people around him.

However, an unexpected marriage proposal finds its way to Nova. The other party belongs to a great noble house that rules the northern domain—the Archgate family, which is currently at the height of its prosperity despite a long-standing feud with the Fors family. Furthermore, his prospective bride is, astonishingly, the head of the Archgate family herself, Chia...

"I have been in love with you... ever since that time."

Thus, the third son of the Fors family, a man who possesses nothing, finds himself welcoming a wife of excellent character and stunning beauty—or rather, a wife who is simply perfect in every regard. She is a woman destined to change Nova's fate, determined to give him everything.

"People say all sorts of terrible things about the head of the Archgate family—that she is terrifying, cold-blooded, and ruthless. But Chia is cute, kind, smart, and absolutely perfect."

This marks the beginning of the married life between the easygoing Nova, and Chia, who reveals her true self to no one but him.

description.en: Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai. The 5,000 yen is to buy three hours of Sendai's time, which gives the right for Miyagi to give her orders. Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who never crossed paths at school, spend time together after school under such a contract. Miyagi's orders are determined by her mood of the day, and Sendai cannot disobey. One day after school... Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an order that she usually does not give.
description.ja:
クラスメイトの宮城から、週に一度五千円でどんな“命令”でも聞くことになった仙台。陰キャ女子と陽キャ女子、学校では交わらない二人の関係は、密室の部屋の中で少しずつエスカレートしていく…。

『仙台さんの役目は、私の言うことを聞くことだから』

ゲームの相手から宿題の代行…、やがて宮城の肌に仙台の唇が触れて…。
description.vi:
Sau khi nhận lời đề nghị của Miyagi, bạn cùng lớp, Sendai bắt đầu thực hiện bất kỳ “mệnh lệnh” nào với giá 5.000 yên mỗi tuần.

Một cô gái hướng nội và một cô gái hướng ngoại—hai người vốn chẳng hề giao lưu với nhau ở trường, nhưng trong căn phòng kín, mối quan hệ của họ dần trở nên táo bạo hơn…

“Nhiệm vụ của Sendai-san là nghe lời tôi.”

Từ việc làm bạn chơi game đến làm hộ bài tập… và rồi, đôi môi của Sendai chạm vào làn da của Miyagi.
description.es-la: Una vez a la semana, Miyagi paga 5.000 yenes a su compañera de clase Sendai.Los 5.000 yenes son para comprar tres horas de tiempo de Sendai, lo que da derecho a Miyagi a darle órdenes.Miyagi está en la parte baja de la casta escolar mientras que Sendai está en la alta. Las dos, que nunca se han cruzado en la escuela, pasan tiempo juntas después de clase bajo este contrato.Las órdenes de Miyagi vienen determinadas por su estado de ánimo del día, y Sendai no puede desobedecerlas.Un día después de clase... Miyagi llama a Sendai a su habitación y le da una orden que no suele dar.

Ichika, de 17 años, es un poco extraña, y su afecto por Tomoya es bastante abrumador, incluso inquietante. Además, la amiga de Ichika, Ruri, es una sádica empedernida. description.en:
Every 1000 years, 100 demon children are sent to Earth to compete in a battle to become king of the Demon World. Each demon is paired with a human partner who is given a spell book of a specific color. The human can cast the demon's spells through their book. If a demon's book is burned, they disappear and return to the Demon World. The last demon remaining becomes the king. The show is oriented around Gash Bell and his human partner, Takamine Kiyomaro.  
  
---
- **Won the 48th Shogakukan Manga Award for Shonen**
description.pt-br:
Takamine Kiyomaro é um estudante gênio do ensino médio, muito convencido e que vê todos os outros como inferiores. Ele se fecha para o resto da escola, sendo um excluso por opção. Um dia, um estranho garotinho loiro invade sua casa trazendo consigo um livro vermelho e uma carta de seu pai. O rapaz descobre que o nome do garoto é Gash e que ele perdeu a memória, então seu pai lhe pede para cuidar do menino.

Muito irritado com a inesperada responsabilidade, Kiyomaro volta sua atenção para o estranho livro, também mencionado na carta de seu pai, que possui letras estranhas de cor azul, as quais ele não consegue entender. Folheando o curioso objeto o rapaz encontra palavras escritas em vermelho, e apesar de estarem em uma língua que ele nunca viu, consegue lê-las como se estivesse em japonês, e ao pronunciar as palavras vermelhas "Zakeru", um estranho relâmpago é então atirado da boca de Gash, como se fosse um raio, porém, o garotinho perde a consciência ao atirá-lo, não entendendo como o quarto de seu anfitrião parecia ter sido explodido de uma hora para outra.

Com o desenrolar da história Kiyomaro conhece outro humano com um livro e uma criança, que por sua vez revela que os estranhos garotos não passam de crianças demônios, que estão competindo em um torneio para decidir quem será o próximo rei de seu mundo. Os livros representam os feitiços que cada criança pode usar para lutar, e explicam também que uma criança demônio não pode usar seus poderes sozinho no mundo humano; eles precisam primeiro procurar por um parceiro que possa ler seus livros e comandar seus feitiços em batalha.

Para derrotar um oponente, basta queimar o livro do adversário e ele será mandado de volta para o mundo dos demônios. Depois de ponderar muito o rapaz decide ajudar Gash a recuperar sua memória e a  lutar nessa guerra contra os outros 99 demônios para torná-lo o próximo rei. Descobrindo pelo caminho o valor individual de cada pessoa, Kiyomaro irá relembrar sentimentos há muito tempo enterrados e o valor de uma verdadeira amizade.

description.en:
In a certain place, there are two neighboring high schools. Chidori High School, a bottom-feeder boys' school where idiots gather, and Kikyo Girls' School, a well-established girls' school. Rintaro Tsumugi, a strong and quiet second year student at Chidori High School, meets Kaoruko Waguri, a girl who comes as a customer while helping out at his family's cake shop. Rintaro feels comfortable spending time with Kaoruko, but she is a student at Kikyo Girls, a neighboring school that thoroughly dislikes Chidori High.

description.fr:
Au cœur d'une banlieue japonaise, se dressent face à face deux établissements que tout oppose : Chidori, le lycée public pour garçons, réunit les pires cancres de la ville, tandis que le prestigieux Kikyô rassemble les esprits les plus brillants des filles de bonne famille.

Donnant régulièrement un coup de main à la pâtisserie familiale, Rintarô Tsumugi, élève à Chidori, sympathise avec l'une de ses clientes régulières, Kaoruko Waguri. Alors qu'il sent peu à peu un lien se tisser entre eux, le lycéen apprend que la jeune fille fréquente Kikyô et que comme tous les élèves de ces établissements, ils sont supposés se haïr mutuellement ! La rivalité entre leurs lycées est-elle forcément signe de fatalité ?
description.ja: とある場所に、隣接するふたつの高校がある。バカが集まる底辺男子校・千鳥高校と、由緒正しきお嬢様校・桔梗女子。強面で物静かな千鳥高校２年・紬 凛太郎は、実家のケーキ屋の手伝い中にお客として来ていた少女・和栗薫子と出会う。薫子との時間を心地よく感じる凛太郎だったが、彼女は徹底して千鳥を嫌う桔梗女子の生徒で……！？
description.vi: Ở một nơi nào đó, có 2 trường cao trung lân cận. Cao trung Chidori, một trường nam sinh cấp thấp hội tụ đủ những thằng đần, trường nữ sinh Kikyo, một trường nữ sinh danh giá . Rintaro Tsugumi, một nam sinh năm 2 to khỏe và trầm tính tại trường Chidori, bắt gặp Kaoruko Waguri, một khách hàng khi cậu đang giúp việc tại cửa hàng bánh nhà mình . Rintaro cảm thấy thoải mái khi dành thời gian bên Kaoruko, nhưng cô lại là học sinh của trường Kikyo, ngôi trường hàng xóm cực kì căm ghét trường Chidori. Đây là câu chuyện về 2 con người ở rất gần nhưng lại rất xa
description.es-la:
En cierto lugar, hay dos escuelas secundarias vecinas. El instituto Chidori, una escuela masculina de mala muerte en la que se reúnen los idiotas, y el instituto femenino Kikyo, una escuela femenina bien establecida. Rintaro Tsumugi, un fuerte y tranquilo estudiante de segundo curso del instituto Chidori, conoce a Kaoruko Wakuri, una chica que llega como cliente mientras ayuda en la pastelería de su familia. Rintaro se siente cómodo pasando tiempo con Kaoruko, pero ella es alumna de las chicas de Kikyo, una escuela vecina a la que no le gusta nada el instituto Chidori. Esta es la historia de dos personas que están tan cerca y a la vez tan lejos.

description.pt-br: Em um lugar específico, existem duas escolas secundárias vizinhas. A Escola Secundária Chidori, uma escola para rapazes considerada de nível inferior, onde se reúnem estudantes menos dedicados, e a Escola para Meninas Kikyo, uma instituição bem estabelecida. Rintaro Tsumugi, um estudante do segundo ano forte e tranquilo da Escola Secundária Chidori, conhece Kaoruko Waguri, uma garota que aparece como cliente enquanto ajuda na confeitaria da sua família. Rintaro se sente à vontade passando tempo com Kaoruko, mas ela é uma aluna da Escola para Meninas Kikyo, uma escola vizinha que tem aversão à Escola Secundária Chidori. Esta é a história de duas pessoas que estão tão próximas e, ao mesmo tempo, tão distantes.
