description.en:
Ikurumi Akuto is the top of his class in every subject, including sports, and he knows it. The son of a well-known politician, a degree of arrogance is to be expected. But Akuto takes it to a new extreme with his condescending and self-important attitude. It doesn't help matters that his effeminate voice makes him a target of constant ridicule by his "lower class" schoolmates.  
  
Then Harusaka Nari enters his life, and Akuto's controlling personality is thrown off kilter by the optimistic but manipulating young seiyuu. With his life on the line, he agrees to be a voice in her Anime Research Society's project for the upcoming Cultural Festival... as the female lead?!

description.en: High school girl Hinako is living a quiet life in a seaside town, but she feels somewhat detached from her friends during the summer months when she is reminded of when her family died years ago. One day, she meets Shiori, a mysterious girl who reminds her of the ocean, especially when it comes to her translucent blue eyes, but Shiori soon reveals that she is actually a mermaid who has been looking for Hinako for a long time.
description.ru: Старшеклассница Хинако живет обычной жизнью в городке на морском побережье. Однажды она встречает Шиори, загадочную девушку с глазами цвета океана, но вскоре оказывается, что Шиори — на самом деле русалка, которая наблюдала за Хинако уже долгое время.
description.pt-br:
“Vim te devorar.”

É o que sussurra docemente a sereia Shiori, de olhos tão azuis quanto o oceano, ao emergir do mar e tomar a mão da estudante do ensino médio Hinako.

Hinako vive sozinha em uma cidade à beira-mar, presa às lembranças de um passado que se afoga dentro dela — um sofrimento que a faz desejar desaparecer junto com o mar.

Seu corpo, no entanto, guarda um sabor irresistível para as criaturas das profundezas.

Para que Hinako alcance sua forma mais “perfeita”, Shiori decide protegê-la... tudo para que, um dia, possa devorar cada parte dela.

Mas conforme esse destino inevitável se aproxima, o que será dos sentimentos que nascem dentro de Hinako?

description.ja: バドミントン部に所属する猪股大喜（いのまたたいき）は、女子バスケ部の先輩・鹿野千夏（かのちなつ）に恋をしていた――。自主練を真摯に取り組む姿に心惹かれていたが、思いもよらぬ事実が発覚し…！？道のりは遠く、想いは近く。
description.kk: Тайки Иномата - спортқа терең бағытталған Еймей орта және жоғары мектебінің бадминтон тобында ойнайды. Ол әр таң сайын мектеп спортзалында онымен бірге жаттығатын Чинацу Кано атты үздік баскетболшы сенпайға ғашық. Бір күні олардың қарым - қатынасы өзгеріске ұшырап, арасындағы қашықтық жойыла бастады... Осылай, көктемнің бір кезінде мектеп спорт залында тағы да бір махаббат, спорт және жастық шақ оқиғасы басталды.
description.tl: Si Taiki Inomata ay nasa boys' badminton team na sports powerhouse ng Eimei Junior at Senior High. In love siya sa basketball player na si Chinatsu Kano, ang babaeng mas matanda sa kaniya na kasama niya magpraktis kada umaga sa gym. Isang araw, ang kanilang relasyon ay biglang nagbago.
description.uk:
Тайкі Іномата — учасник команди з бадмінтону, який вчиться у школі Еймей. Щодня він намагається прийти до школи якомога раніше, але його завжди випереджає Чінацу Кано, в яку він закоханий.

Чінацу — зірка команди з баскетболу. Хоч Тайкі добре грає в бадмінтон, він далеко не настільки популярний, як Чінацу, що робить шанси на взаємну симпатію низькими. Але за дивним поворотом долі Чінацу починає жити в його будинку.
description.vi:
Taiki Inomata, năm ba sơ trung, là thành viên của đội cầu lông. Kể từ khi tập luyện cùng với đội cầu lông, cậu luôn cố đến sớm nhất có thể, thế nhưng, cậu chỉ là người thứ hai đến nhà đa năng. Bởi vì người đầu tiên luôn đến sớm nhất, chính là Chinatsu Kano, năm nhất cao trung, và là người mà cậu thích.

Vì sự chênh lệch giữa mức độ nổi tiếng mà cậu cảm thấy mình không thể kéo gần khoảng cách với cô ấy. Thế nhưng...

Vào một ngày đẹp trời, vì chuyện gia đình, Chinatsu Kano đã đến sống chung với Taiki Inomata.

Với cơ hội ngàn năm có một này, với cái flag romcom to hơn núi Phú Sĩ này, liệu rằng cậu chàng Taiki có thể làm nên chuyện hay không?

description.en: In 2011, childhood friends Yasuho Hirose and Joushuu Higashikata discover a naked man buried in the ground just outside the town of Morioh. The man has no memory of his name or previous life; the only thing he remembers about himself is how to use his Stand, a supernatural ability that takes the form of a humanoid creature. The stranger is quickly given a name, Jousuke, and Joushuu's father Norisuke decides to adopt him into the Higashikata household until he can find his own home.  As Jousuke begins to investigate his past, it becomes apparent that he is no ordinary amnesiac. There is much more to his identity than he first suspected, and, as he is thrust into a series of high-stakes Stand battles, he soon begins unravelling a deadly conspiracy that encompasses the entire town.
description.hu:
A Jojo no Kimyou na Bouken sorozat nyolcadik történetíve.

A nagy japán földrengést követően Morioh-t hatalmas földkiugrások sújtották, ahogy helyiek nevezik, Szemes falak. A vizsgálat ellenére a szakmai becslések üresen maradtak. Eközben egy fiatal lány, Yasuho Hirose egy férfit talál a földbe temetve,aki jellegzetes csillagalakú anyajeggyel és mélyre hatoló harapásnyomokkal rendelkezik. A férfit, aki az aminézia jeleit mutatja, egy helyi család hozta ide és adta neki a Josuke Higashikata nevet, azonban a különös események nem maradnak abba, egyik a másikat halmozza leginkább és hamarosan a standként ismert talány előbukkan, hogy eloszlassa a zavarságok felhőit. 

- 2013-ban a 17-dik Japan Media Arts Festivalon megnyerte a fődíjat a manga kategóriában.
description.pl:
Ósma część serii JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. 
Począwszy od trzęsień ziemi w 2011, w miasteczku Morioh zaczęły występować rozległe uskoki, nazwane Murami Oczu. Pomimo przeprowadzonych badań, przyczyna ich wzniesienia pozostaje nieznana. W międzyczasie młoda dziewczyna imieniem Yasuho Hirose znajduje zakopanego mężczyznę ze znamieniem w kształcie gwiazdy otoczonym śladami ugryzienia. Mężczyzna przyjąwszy łatkę człowieka z amnezją, został przyjęty do mieszkającej w pobliżu rodziny oraz nadano mu imię - Jōsuke Higashikata. Jednakże, tajemnicze wydarzenia wcale nie ustają, a zagadkowe Standy dopełniają poczucie zdezorientowania.
- Czarno-biała wersja wygrała główną nagrodę w kategorii mangi w 17 edycji Japońskiego Festiwalu Sztuki w 2013 roku.
description.es-la:
El arco de la octava historia de la serie: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.

Tras el gran terremoto del este en Japón, Morioh ha sido golpeado por grandes protuberancias de tierra conocidas por los lugareños como Los Muros con Ojos. A pesar de la investigación, las estimaciones profesionales quedan vacías. Mientras tanto, la joven Yasuho Hirose, descubre a un hombre enterrado en la tierra, este posee una distintiva marca de nacimiento en forma de estrella junto con marcas de mordeduras profundas. El hombre, que ha contraído un caso básico de amnesia, es acogido por una familia local y recibe el nombre de Jousuke Higashikata, sin embargo, los eventos misteriosos no pueden evitar que se acumulen unos sobre otros y pronto ese enigma conocido como "stand", emerge para complementar la gran nube de confusión.

° Ganó el Gran Premio en la categoría de manga en el 17º Festival de Artes de Medios de Japón en 2013.

description.en: That day, Ishida Yamada was working his part-time job as usual. By sheer chance, Ishida was chosen by this God to be transported to another world. Although confused and uncertain, he resolved to adapt and make a life for himself in this strange new place. Organized crime meets family drama and unbelievable enemy Stands in JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Part 5—Golden Wind!
description.it:
Napoli, 2001. Giorno Giovana è un piccolo criminale con il grande sogno di diventare una "Gang-Star". Giorno ha una connessione con la linea sanguigna Joestar, e possiede lo stand "Gold Experience". Il suo sogno inizia a diventare realtà quando incontra Bruno Bucciarati, un partecipante della gang "Passione" e un portatore di stand. Giunti alla conclusione che tutti e due hanno idee simili, e che unanimamente non concordano sugli affari della gang, Giorno rivela il suo obiettivo: con l'aiuto di Bruno, riformerà Passione spodestando il capo della gang.

Giorno, una volta diventato membro di Passione ed entrato nella squadra di Bucciarati, scopre che non è una semplice gang, è piena di portatori di stand. Una volta confrontatesi con le altre squadre, sleali e imprevedibili, scoprono che il loro obiettivo di cambiare la gang dall'interno non sarà facile da raggiungere. Parlando a proposito di questi avversari, Gioeno tenta di ralire tra i ranghi per avvicinarsi al boss, un uomo circondato dal mistero.

description.en:
Hunter Cha Euijae, sent to seal a rift over the West Sea, was flung out after closing it. When he regain consciousness, he found himself in a garbage dump — eight years in the future.

Starving, he stumbled into a hangover soup restaurant and realized the world had changed. Now, disaster alerts warn of rift openings, slime ASMR videos are trending, and hunters livestream A-rank sword unboxings. Instead of the looming apocalypse, the future is oddly peaceful, leaving Cha Euijae feeling empty. 

Deciding to leave his hunter days behind, he chooses to work part-time at the restaurant. But his quiet new life takes a turn when he meets a mysterious figure in a gas mask…

"I did it again...!"

The Hero who can't seem to set out on his journey!!

To repay the world that accepted him , he decides to set out on a journey... However, he can't seem to leave the first village, as he is constantly tempted by charming heroines such as the female priestess, his childhood friend who is a magician, and so on!

description.en:
The fifth official Touhou manga (and the first webcomic) written by ZUN and originally drawn by Ginmokusei. 

Touhou Chireikiden focuses on Satori Komeiji's endeavors as a detective, solving mysteries around Gensokyo.

*Serialization was paused for a few months after volume 2 was finished due to the health concerns of the original artist Ginmokusei. The series resumed serialization with Yuu Akimaki as the new artist.*

description.tr: Danmaku geri planda kalıyor, Satori'nin inanılmaz dedektiflik yetenekleri ön gösteriye geliyor... Bu mangada "olaylar" yerine "davalar" oluyor ve Satori de bunları çözüyor.
description.vi:
Manga chính thức thứ 5 của Touhou, kịch bản được viết bởi ZUN và được minh họa bởi Ginmonkusei (Sau này được đổi thành Akimaki Yuu vì sức khỏe của Ginmonkusei có vấn đề) 

Bộ truyện tập trung vào Satori Komeji, một yêu quái có khả năng đọc tâm trí người khác, cô bắt đầu trở thành thám tử và đi giải quyết các vụ án ở khắp Ảo Tưởng Hương.
description.es-la:
Cada vez que en Gensokyo se produce un incidente en el que está involucrado un youkai, la sacerdotisa Reimu Hakurei suele resolver la situación confrontando al culpable. Sin embargo, los casos en los que los culpables ocultan su identidad suelen ser demasiado complejos como para que la exterminadora de youkais se encargue de ello.

Entra en escena Satori Komeiji. Como youkai satori, posee un tercer ojo que le permite leer las mentes, detectando a cualquier criminal sin importar las mentiras que pueda inventarse. Con su extraordinaria aptitud como detective, Satori es capaz de resolver todos los misterios que se le plantea, aunque no siempre quiera salir de su mansión.
description.pt-br:
Touhou Chireikiden é a primeira webcomic oficial da série Touhou Project, escrita por ZUN com ilustrações da novata Ginmokusei, apresentando Satori Komeiji como a mestra detetive das profundezas da Terra.

Pode ser lido em japonês gratuitamente no web blog oficial: https://touhougarakuta.com/comic/touhouchireikiden_1/

description.ca:
L'Aya, una estudiant que va a la moda, perd el cap pel treballador d'una botiga de discos.
Té un aire de misteri, un gran estil i un gust musical impecable.
Tot i això, ella no sap que aquest treballador és de fet una companya de classe, la Mitsuki!
description.en:
Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He’s got an air of mystery about him, always dressed well, and has impeccable taste in music. Little does she know — this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki!

Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya’s, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other’s crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question — but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn’t be so bad...

***Overwhelming winner in the Web category of the 2023 Tsugimanga Awards (by Kadokawa).***
description.es:
Aya, una estudiante de secundaria alegre y de moda, se enamora perdidamente de un empleado de una tienda de CD local.
Tiene un aire de misterio, un gran estilo y un gusto musical impecable.
Lo que ella no sabe es que...
description.fr:
Une histoire très appréciée sur Twitter sur fond de musique de Rock.

Aya, une populaire lycéenne tombe sous le charme du discret vendeur du magasin de musique qu'elle fréquente.

Retour en classe, elle raconte toute l'histoire à ses amies et comment elle a un faible pour ce garçon aux airs de prince charmant.

Ce qu'elle ne sait pas c'est que ce mystérieux vendeur n'est en fait que sa voisine de bureau, Mitsuki, qu'elle a confondu pour un jeune homme.

Comment leur relation va-t-elle évoluer ? Arriveront-elles à expliquer ce quiproquo ?
description.id:
Series Pendek Twitter yang menggambarkan cerita tentang Gyaru dan Teman Sekelasnya.
Gyaru yang suka musik rock dan sering mendatangi toko kaset jatuh cinta ke pekerja paruh waktu yang bekerja disitu, tapi sedikit dia tahu ternyata pekerjanya itu perempuan dan teman sekelasnya.
description.tr:
Modayı seven ve enerjiyle dolu lise öğrencisi Aya, bir CD mağazasındaki çalışana sırılsıklam âşık oluyor. Âşık olduğu kişinin etrafında bir gizem havası var, her zaman şık kıyafetler giyiyor ve mükemmel bir müzik zevki var. Ancak bilmediği bir şey var: Bu sözde erkek çalışan aslında onun sınıfındaki kızlardan biri olan Mitsuki!

Mitsuki genelde kendi hâlinde takılıyor ancak oturduğu sıra Aya'nın hemen yanında olduğu için onun hoşlandığı kişiyi sürekli duymadan edemiyor. Gerçeği ortaya çıkarmak söz konusu bile değil ama belki de Aya ile yakınlaşmak çok da kötü bir fikir olmayabilir...

Cậu còn phải thường xuyên đối phó với người cha mê nữ trang, người gần như ngày nào cũng ép cậu phải “giả gái”. Thế nhưng một ngày nọ, Karen bất ngờ được tiết lộ một bí mật trọng đại đã được lưu truyền qua nhiều thế hệ trong gia tộc Mikogami...!?

Daily Chaldea is an unofficial daily slice-of-life fancomic created using art assets from the game Fate/Grand Order and building upon the existing lore of the franchise.

The story follows the adventures of genderswapping protagonist Ritsuka Fujimaru and the many Servants they've summoned, with the tone ranging from comedic to philosophical. The comic is 'live' with the NA server of Fate/Grand Order, with new characters appearing in the comic around the time they appear in the game and comics often referencing recent events in the game.

Enjoyment of this comic relies heavily upon the reader's familiarity with the game and its characters, so the author recommends playing Fate/Grand Order before reading this comic.

---

This comic is being uploaded to MangaDex by reader request and with the approval of MangaDex staff. All art is copyright TYPE-Moon / FGO Project, Aniplex Inc., Lasengle, and other copyright holders as appropriate. This comic is not for profit (through ad revenue or otherwise).

Some early use the original white backgrounds. Later comics have darker backgrounds and additional art assets for improved quality.

Alice Ryouhei will leave high school soon, but he's trying to avoid thinking about his future. Late one night, when he's hanging out with his tough friend Karube and his silly, girl-crazy friend Chota, they see fireworks. After one blindingly bright explosion, they find themselves waking up in a different world. In this 'Borderland,' people are forced to either participate in potentially deadly games or simply die. description.ja: 同作は板垣の「グラップラー刃牙」シリーズに登場する、烈海王を主人公としたスピンオフ。今号には一挙3話掲載されており、本編で命を落とした烈が異世界に転生して戸惑うさまや、同じく「刃牙」の世界から転生したある人物と出会うシーンなどが描かれている。陸井は月刊少年チャンピオンで連載していた「月チャン編集部の秋田書店オンラインストア向上委員会」の中で烈海王の異世界転生ものを連載したい旨をアピールしていたため、このたびそれが実現した形だ。今号のカラーページには、担当編集者が連載の企画書を板垣に持ち込んだ際のレポートも掲載されており、板垣は連載の許可について特に返答していないものの、編集部は「最終手段。非公認のまま始めます！！」としている。

description.en:
Tomoko Kuroki naturally assumed she'd be popular when she got to high school… but then cold, hard reality swooped in for the attack! Turns out all the popularity points she's racked up in her video game dating sims are worth squat in real life, and Tomoko's far from prepared to navigate high school! How can she possibly hope to impress her classmates when she can't even talk to them!?
___
**Official English Volumes:** [Yen Press](https://yenpress.com/series/no-matter-how-i-look-at-it-it-s-you-guys-fault-i-m-not-popular)
description.ja: 高校に行けば自然とモテると思っていた黒木智子…。しかし、無残な現実が襲いかかって来る！この状況をどう打破するか？
description.pl: Główna bohaterka serii – Kuroki Tomoko – jest ultra-popularną uczennicą liceum, która umówiła się już z ponad setką chłopaków… W grach Otome. W realnym świecie jest socjopatką, która zupełnie nie radzi sobie z komunikacją z innymi ludźmi, a w szczególności z płcią przeciwną. Manga opowiada o jej kuriozalnych próbach (z reguły niezbyt udanych) usocjalnienia się i zmienienia się w osobę bardziej popularną.
description.es-la: Kuroki Tomoko, una chica que tiene "50 años de experiencia" en citas y que ha salido con más de un centenar de chicos… en juegos otome. En la vida real acaba de cumplir 15 años y va a dar comienzo su época en el instituto, está convencida de que con sus conocimientos será la más de popular. Una vez comienza el instituto, comienzan a pasar los días y se da cuenta de que no habla con nadie. ¿Cómo es posible? Un simple vistazo al espejo le hace darse cuenta de la realidad: no es precisamente una belleza y parece que hasta puede ser antipática. Poco a poco intentará cambiar para ser popular, pero claro, entre lo que le cuesta y lo que tiene una idea bastante distorsionada de la realidad, no será tan sencillo.
description.pt-br:
Tomoko Kuroki naturalmente presumiu que ela seria popular quando chegasse ao ensino médio... mas então a realidade fria e dura se abateu para o ataque! Acontece que todos os pontos de popularidade que ela acumulou em seus simuladores de namoro de videogame valem a pena na vida real, e Tomoko está longe de estar preparada para passar pelo ensino médio!

Como ela pode esperar impressionar seus colegas quando ela nem consegue falar com eles?! Nasce uma nova heroína do ensino médio (talvez?)!

description.en: The villainous noble, Zenon Restinata, is a disappointing "underdog" who gets beaten up by the protagonist in the original anime. "I," a mere fan of the original work, have possessed such a Zenon!? This place is completely the world of the anime, and when I tried out magic for starters, it was super fun. I've decided-- I'm going to change Zenon's disappointing ending! The "do-over" life of a magic maniac begins!!
description.ja: 悪役貴族のゼノン・レスティナータは、原作アニメで主人公にボコされる残念な“かませ犬”。そんなゼノンに、ただの原作ファンの“俺”が憑依!?そこは完全にアニメの世界で、手始めに魔法を試したらチョー楽しい。決めた――俺がゼノンの残念な結末を変えてやる！魔法狂いの“原作やり直し”ライフ開幕!!

description.en:
Three years ago**, Gu Nian and Fu Jingshen **split on bad terms** over a misunderstanding. Concealing the truth, she fled to Seattle to study abroad. **Now**, with the Gu family in crisis, Gu Nian has no choice but to **spend a night with Fu Jingshen** and force him into marriage to save her family.  

As they reconnect, **past sweetness clashes with present misunderstandings**, pulling them back into a whirlwind of uncertainty.
description.ru: Гу Нянь расстается с Фу Цзин Шеном и уезжает учиться в Сиэтл. Три года спустя семья Гу переживает кризис, и, чтобы спасти семью, Гу Нянь не остается ничего другого, как провести ночь с Фу Цзин Шеном, а затем выйти замуж. По мере того как они вступают в контакт друг с другом, сладость прошлого и непонимание настоящего постоянно переплетаются, и оба снова оказываются в ловушке!

description.en:
Choi Yeon was abandoned by her friends and family. Now a university student, she has started working as a private tutor for a son of a rich family in Seongbuk-dong to hide her poverty. By chance, while working there she met Ji Shinhyuk, the older brother of her student.

Shinhyuk, the real owner of the house, completely ignored Yeon as if she was a mere object. But one day, he began to call on Yeon to perform menial errands. Some days, he would be crude; others, disrespectful. He would provoke Yeon with his indecipherable expression. Despite that, Yeon began to foster a growing attraction toward Shinhyuk, and hoped she would eventually catch his eye...

---

description.ru: Чхве Ён - юная девушка-сирота, пытающаяся спастись от бедности. Она устраивается частным репетитором в особняк богатой семьи, где знакомится с высокомерным и властолюбивым Джи Шинхёком, старшим сыном семьи. Он обращается с ней как с бесчувственным объектом, но в то же время его влечет к ней. Ён оказывается вовлеченной в опасную игру обольщения и доминирования, где все не так, как кажется. Сможет ли она устоять перед обаянием Шинхёка или станет всего лишь одной из сломанных вещей, которые он коллекционирует?

description.en: Aijo Rentaro has asked a hundred girls out and struck out every time. In desperation, he prays for guidance, only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to a cosmic mishap! Now this god will set things right by making sure Aijo gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often go with gods, there’s a catch: each of his one hundred dates is Aijo’s destined soulmate! Worse, if he doesn’t return their feelings, they’ll all die in horrible - and hilarious - accidents!
description.es:
Rentaro Aijou es una máquina de declararse y de recibir calabazas, consiguiendo la cifra de 100 rechazos al final de la secundaria. Roto por dentro, va a rezar a un santuario de suerte en el amor para pedir que la fortuna le sonría. Para su sorpresa, el dios del santuario se le aparece y le promete que conocerá a 100 almas gemelas durante el bachillerato.

Aunque al principio cree que le ha tomado el pelo, el primer día de clase se le declaran dos chicas en cuanto lo conocen, así que ve que sus rezos funcionaron y la cosa pinta bien. Sin embargo, hay un pequeño detalle que el dios no le explicó: si alguna de estas almas gemelas no consigue establecer una relación con él, esa chica morirá. Su gran corazón hace que no pueda permitir que eso suceda en ningún caso y por eso, ¡decide que saldrá con todas ellas!

¡Su nueva e inesperada vida de bachillerato, llena de amor, confusiones y un montón de chicas, le depara una sorpresa tras otra!

(Fuente: Editorial Ivrea)
description.ja: 「好き」っていいたい！いわれたい！中学卒業式に100回目の失恋をした愛城恋太郎は、高校でこそ初めての彼女を！と願う。そんな彼の前に現れた恋の神様が告げた未来は「高校生活で出会う“運命の人”は100人。しかし彼女達は、幸せになれなければなんやかんや（中略）あって…死ぬ」　突然始まるDEAD OR LOVEな純愛ハーレムライフ!!　絶対に脱落しない・させない！
description.ru: Что может быть хуже отказа на признание в любви? Сотня отказов на признание в любви! Айдзё Рэнтаро – безнадёжный романтик, признавшийся в любви уже сто раз, но по необъяснимым причинам каждый раз получавший отказ. В один прекрасный день перед ним предстаёт сам Бог Любви и говорит, что его ужасная удача в любви обернулась вспять! Теперь Айдзё предстоит встретить 100 девушек "Соулмейтов" – каждая из них предназначена ему самой судьбой и без памяти влюблена в него! Но вот беда: ни у одного человека не должно быть столько соулмейтов. Если он не ответит хоть одной из них взаимностью, девушку ждёт смерть от несчастного случая! Теперь это дело любви и смерти, а выбор за Айдзё.
description.pt-br: Aijou é um garoto que tem muito azar no amor e já foi rejeitado mais de 100 vezes. Desesperado ele vai num templo pedir ajuda aos deuses. E seu desejo foi atendido, para cada rejeição ele terá uma alma gêmea. Mas isso se tona uma maldição quando ele fica sabendo que se elas não forem felizes ao lado de sua alma gêmea, ele, elas vão morrer… Mas que merda, você ainda está lendo isso? Não escutou? São 100 garotas, 100! Não há tempo a perder!

description.en:
One day, ordinary elementary school student Mitsuo Suwa meets an alien in an empty lot, who appoints him as the hero of justice, "Perman No. 1"! Together with the chimpanzee No. 2, the tomboyish girl with an unknown identity No. 3, and reliable Osaka native No. 4, they save lives and fight evil!

The series gained huge popularity in the late 1960s in Weekly Shonen Sunday and educational magazines for different grades, and was continued in the 1980s with a new setting. This version includes all episodes, including early versions not available in the original volumes and the stories featuring Perman No. 5, as well as the magazine's feature pages and the bonus features on the back cover of the original comic.

description.es-la: Usami, una hermosa compañera de clase, modelo de buena conducta y la mejor en calificaciones, me ve como su rival en la escuela. Sin embargo, después de clases, ella muestra una faceta completamente diferente. Después de la escuela, juega en la sala de juegos y muestra una inocente sonrisa que no podrías imaginar viendo en la escuela. Para acercarme a Usami, la acompañó en la escuela y jugamos juntos después de clases. En cada lugar, nuestra amistad se profundiza, ¡y finalmente se abre el telón de una conmovedora comedia romántica de triángulo amoroso!
description.pt-br:
Usami é uma linda colega de classe, com bons costumes e notas altas. Na escola, ela vê Sakuto como seu rival. Mas quando ele a encontra depois da escola, ele vê um lado diferente dela. Ela estava jogando no fliperama depois das aulas e tinha aquele sorriso inocente que ninguém poderia imaginar nela na escola.

Para se dar bem com ela, ele se aproxima dela na escola e depois joga com ela depois da escola. Cada um deles tem seus lugares onde podem aprofundar seus laços e, finalmente...

Este é o início de uma comédia romântica de triângulo amoroso comovente!

description.en: Modern Japan - One night when a meteor shower fell, dungeons infested with strange monsters appeared all over the world. People all over the world were now able to check their own "status". The days of peace have come to an end, and it has become people's duty to go into dungeons and hunt monsters. All humans are ranked according to their status, and the main character, Takashi Nakamura, who only has the lowest-ranked abilities, is ridiculed, but spends his hard days hiding in dungeons as a burden carrier for the strong. However, Takashi's fate begins to change when he encounters the B-rank monster Argos in the dungeon. Takashi can now freely teleport to a game-like fantasy [different world], and his experience points there can now be reflected in his current status.

description.id: Alba, seorang petualang pemalas yang ingin kaya agar bisa hidup santai, tanpa sengaja memperoleh Holy Sword (Seiken) legendaris. Namun, di dalam pedang itu bersemayam roh Holy Sword (Seiken) yang tsundere, rumit, dan tidak percaya pada manusia. Kisah fantasi aksi dan komedi romantis pun dimulai antara petualang yang malas dan Holy Sword (Seiken)-chan yang sulit jujur pada perasaannya.
description.ja: 怠惰な冒険者アルバは、楽をして生きるために財宝を探していた。そんな彼が偶然手にしたのは、人間嫌いでこじらせた聖剣の精霊が宿る伝説の聖剣。面倒くさがりの冒険者とツンデレ聖剣ちゃんが紡ぐ、バトル＆ラブコメファンタジー。

Since then, he’s spent nights with various partners, but no matter what he does, he’s never been able to experience the same pleasure he felt that day and before he knows it, six years have passed. One day, the man responsible for that unforgettable experience, Kuroda, transfers to Miyakawa’s company. Miyakawa’s heart races at the reunion with his old college friend, but it seems Kuroda isn’t simply happy to see him as a friend…

Yamamoto Kuromi is an unassuming underclassman in her university’s film club. Shiratori Shiori, meanwhile, is an upperclassman who has always enjoyed a happy life thanks to her good looks.

Feeling sorry for Kuromi, who has no friends, Shiratori takes the initiative and invites her out for coffee. However, Kuromi’s bored and indifferent attitude throughout their outing gradually begins to irritate her.

Then, after Shiratori happens to catch a glimpse of a certain side of her underclassman, her ordinary life slowly begins to slip off course…
description.vi:
Yamamoto Kuromi là một cô đàn em mờ nhạt trong CLB điện ảnh ở trường đại học. Shiratori Shiori là cô chị khóa trên đã luôn sống một cuộc đời hạnh phúc nhờ vào vẻ ngoài của bản thân.

Thấy thương cô đàn em không có bạn bè, Shiratori chủ động rủ cô đi uống cà phê. Thế nhưng, thái độ chán chường của Kuromi suốt buổi khiến Shiratori dần trở nên khó chịu. Rồi một lần tình cờ nhìn thấy “dáng vẻ ấy” của cô đàn em, cuộc sống thường ngày của Shiratori bắt đầu lệch đi từng chút một…

description.en: Kanan is a demon hiding in a high school in the human world to feed on the souls of humans. She sets her sights on a single high school boy, but somehow ends up in a lovers contract with him!? Kanan, who has never been in love, is now filled with new feelings!
description.ja: 人間の魂を喰らうべく、人間界の高校に潜伏する女悪魔・カナン。一人の男子高校生に狙いを定めるが、気づけばなぜか恋人契約を結ぶことに！？しかし恋なんてしたことのないカナンには、未知な感情ばかりで…！甘酸っぱい青春とギャグの嵐！！
description.tr: Kanan, ruhları sömürmek adına liseye sızan dişi bir iblis. Erkek bir öğrenciyi avı olarak seçer ancak... her nasıl oluyorsa ardından kız arkadaşı olmayı kabul eder!? Daha önce aşkı hiç tatmamış olan Kanan, bilinmedik duygularla dolup taşıyor! Saf kalpli iblisimizin ilk aşkını anlatan sevimli romantik komedi başlıyor!
description.vi: Kanan là một con quỷ ẩn náu trong một trường trung học ở thế giới loài người để ăn linh hồn của con người. Cô ấy để ý đến một nam sinh trung học duy nhất, nhưng bằng cách nào đó lại kết thúc với một hợp đồng tình nhân với anh ta !? Kanan, người chưa từng yêu, giờ đang tràn ngập cảm xúc mới! Bộ truyện hài lãng mạn về mối tình đầu của một con quỷ có trái tim thuần khiết, bắt đầu!
description.es-la: Kanan es un demonio femenino que se esconde en un instituto del mundo humano para alimentarse de almas humanas. Se fija en uno de los chicos del instituto, pero de alguna manera acaba firmando un contrato de amante con él. Pero Kanan, que nunca se ha enamorado, está llena de emociones desconocidas... ¡Una tormenta de juventud agridulce y bromas! Comienza una bonita comedia romántica de primer amor sobre una Akuma de corazón puro...
description.pt-br: Kanan é uma demônio que se esconde em uma escola secundária no mundo humano para se alimentar de almas humanas. Ela põe em sua mira em um dos alunos da escola mas de alguma forma acaba assinando um contrato de amante com ele! Mas Kanan que nunca esteve apaixonada antes, está cheia de emoções desconhecidas…! Começa uma comédia romântica do primeiro amor de uma Demônio!

description.de:
Make Love, not War! Die junge Hexe Maria versucht mit Sexappeal den Hundertjährigen Krieg zu beenden. Selbst noch Jungfrau und vollkommen unerfahren, schickt sie dafür lieber ihren Hilfsdämon aus, der in verführerischer Frauengestalt den Kriegsherren den Kopf verdrehen soll. Mit ihrer kleinen Friedensbewegung gefährdet sie jedoch Gottes Plan der Geschichte und so dauert es nicht lang, bis sie den gewaltigen Zorn der Erzengel auf sich zieht ...
Kurzweilige Serie in 3 Bänden mit einer humorvollen Fantasy-Story vor der düsteren Kulisse des 100-jährigen Krieges, erscheint parallel mit dem gleichnamigen Anime.
description.en: Maria is a witch living during the Hundred Years' War between England and France. Our young heroine hates war, so to keep the people of the village she protects safe, Maria will use all the power at her disposal to stop the fighting, whether that means conjuring giant dragons or sending her succubus familiar out to mesmerize the warring generals with her charms. But what do the villagers think of her "help"? And what will happen if Heaven notices her interference into human affairs? This story has a funny touch with a little history thrown in!
description.ja: 百年戦争中の中世ヨーロッパ。教会と戦争が人を支配していた時代に、聖女の名を持つ魔女がいた。夢魔をひきつれ時に戦場に現れては強力な魔法で両軍をたたきつぶす最強の魔女・マリア!!……でも実は処女。恋を夢見るお年頃。マリアの暴れっぷりは天上の教会の目にもとまり、ついに大天使ミカエルまでもが地上に降臨する事態に!!　カバーや本体表紙もきっちり収録！

description.en:
My beautiful, big-breasted childhood friend, Mikoto, is completely in love with me.
It sounds like a dream scenario that anyone would envy — but there’s just one big problem...
She’s turned into a clingy, mentally unstable mess with love that's way too heavy!!

This is a dark everyday comedy about being at the mercy of Mikoto’s unstable behavior and unintentional sexiness.

The long-awaited book release of the hit everyday romcom — the story of a mentally unstable beauty that took X (formerly Twitter) by storm — featuring all-new, never-before-published chapters!!
description.id:
Teman masa kecilku yang cantik dan berdada besar, Mikoto, sangat mencintaiku.

Kedengarannya seperti skenario impian yang pasti akan membuat siapa pun iri — tapi ada satu masalah besar…

Dia berubah menjadi sosok yang posesif, tidak stabil secara mental, dan cintanya terlalu berat untuk ditanggung!!

Ini adalah komedi gelap sehari-hari tentang hidup dalam bayang-bayang perilaku Mikoto yang labil dan pesonanya yang tak disengaja namun menggoda.

Rilis buku yang telah lama dinantikan dari romcom sehari-hari yang viral di X (sebelumnya Twitter) — menampilkan bab-bab baru yang belum pernah diterbitkan sebelumnya!!
description.ja:
第1巻の内容紹介: キラキラしてないふたりの、いびつな青春。

容姿端麗な巨乳の幼なじみ「みこと」は、オレのことが大好き。
誰もがうらやむシチュエーションには、ひとつ大きな問題が…。
それは愛が重すぎるこじらせメンヘラになってしまったこと！！

そんなみことのメンヘラと無自覚エロに振り回される、日常ブラックコメディ。

Xで話題沸騰のメンヘラ美女との日常ラブコメが、全話描き下ろし新作で待望の書籍化！！
description.pt-br:
Minha linda amiga de infância, Mikoto, de seios grandes, está completamente apaixonada por mim.
Parece um cenário dos sonhos que qualquer um invejaria — mas há um grande problema...
Ela se transformou em uma garota grudenta, emocionalmente instável, com um amor exageradamente pesado!!

Esta é uma comédia sombria do dia a dia sobre estar à mercê do comportamento instável e da sensualidade involuntária de Mikoto.

O tão aguardado lançamento em livro da popular comédia romântica cotidiana — a história de uma bela garota emocionalmente instável que conquistou o X (antigo Twitter) — com capítulos totalmente novos e inéditos!!

description.en:
The world is filthy...

Nakayama, a high schooler with an extreme case of germophobia, just wants to enjoy his own peaceful time in a perfectly clean space, away from everyone else. But his quiet life is constantly thrown into chaos by Nishino, the cheerful, albeit messy girl who just so happens to sit next to him.

"Don't pollute my sanctuary!"
"Don't mess with my alone time!"

Despite his desperate pleas, the madness continues.
description.ja:
「触れたくない。でも、君になら――。」

潔癖をこじらせた高校生・中山は、自分だけのキレイな世界を守るため、細心の注意を払いながら高校生活を過ごしていた。しかし、やたらと距離が近い隣の席の西野さんがお構いなしに絡んできて…？煩わしいはずなのに、気づけば心がざわついてしまう――。

The strongest swordsman of the Warring States period, transferred to another world.

At the end of the Warring States Period, Ginko, the greatest swordsman of the time, was always hungry for a fight to the death with someone stronger than herself. After cutting and cutting and cutting, she finally despairs that there is no one stronger than her in this world, and then she is transferred to another world! Before her eyes - a dragon!

**Award:** Won the Traditional Chinese Global Special Award in the Web category of the 2024 Next Manga Awards.

description.ja:
戦国時代最強の剣豪、異世界転移。

戦国時代末期、最強の剣豪・ギンコは常に、自分より強いものとの死闘に飢えていた。切って切って切りまくり、ついにこの世に自分以上の強者がいないと絶望した矢先、異世界へ転移！目の前には――ドラゴン！？
description.pt-br:
A espadachim mais forte do período dos Reinos Combatentes, transferida para outro mundo.

No final do Período dos Reinos Combatentes, Ginko, a maior espadachim da época, estava sempre ansiosa por lutar até a morte com alguém mais forte que ela. Depois de cortar e cortar e cortar, ela finalmente se desespera porque não há ninguém mais forte do que ela neste mundo, e então ela é transferida para outro mundo! Diante de seus olhos está um dragão!

Dungeons. A romantic setting. However, that’s only for adventurers.

Cleaning, replenishing supplies, and dealing with complaints. Aine and Nacht work hard behind the scenes as floor staff in the dungeon. Damn adventurers.

The dungeon staff now turns its fangs on the adventurers who gather together while not caring about the troubles of others!
description.ja:
ダンジョン。それはロマンあふれる晴れ舞台。ただし、冒険者にとっての。

清掃や備品補充にクレーム対応。アイネとナハトは、今日もダンジョンのフロアスタッフとして裏方稼業に精を出す。

「――クソ冒険者が」

寄って集って他人の迷惑を顧みない冒険者たちに、いまダンジョン側が牙をむく!

description.en: One day, deliveryman Sakunosuke Oda finds a boy at his doorstep on the brink of death. His name is Osamu Dazai, and he is a member of the Port Mafia—the very embodiment of darkness and violence. Thus begins a peculiar living arrangement: Oda, who cares for the boy, and Dazai, who longs to die. But what will become of their newfound connection when a gang of former police officers known as the 48 attack them in search of a certain painting...?!

altTitles.ja: 魔女の終活帳

altTitles.en: The Witch's Ending Note

description.en: Twenty years after the Demon King was defeated by the Hero's party... Dyd, a mortician working at his family's funeral home, encounters Nina-Nina, the legendary witch from the Hero's party. She also happens to be Dyd's "first love." Though she looks like a young girl, Nina-Nina has lived for nearly 2,000 years. Due to the nature of witches, who bring about a calamity if they die leaving behind regrets,  the request Dyd receives is to help with her "end-of-life planning"...!?
description.ja: 勇者パーティによって魔物の王が討たれた二十年後…。家業の葬儀屋で働く葬祭士・ディドは、勇者パーティにいた伝説の魔女・ニナニーナと出会う。――彼女はディドにとって、“初恋の人”でもあった。見た目は少女のようだが、2000年近く生きるニナニーナ。未練を残して死ぬと厄災を起こす魔女の性質のため、ディドに依頼されたのは「終活」の手伝いで…！？

Ác long bị phong ấn suốt 3.000 năm giờ làm bạn với tôi

description.en: Yuuto Kuroma, a 14-year-old with a serious case of chuunibyou, accidentally summons the ultimate Dragon King using a magic circle he had doodled purely on a whim... (Wait, seriously?) On top of that, due to certain circumstances, Yuuto ends up becoming friends with a lonely evil dragon girl who had been sealed away for 3000 years...! Now, the fate of the world is casually entrusted to one unsuspecting boy!
description.fr: Yuuto Kuroma, 14 ans, chuunibyou jusqu’au bout des ongles, invoque sans le vouloir le plus puissant des Rois Dragons avec un cercle magique griffonné au hasard… (Non, c’est pas une blague.) Puis, par un enchaînement improbable, il devient pote avec une dragonne démoniaque solitaire, enfermée depuis trois millénaires… Et voilà que le sort du monde atterrit tranquillement sur les épaules du gars le moins préparé qui soit
description.ja: 召喚してしまったのは、最強のチョロかわ龍王でした。超人気作家の話題作がパワーアップして再始動！！！14歳の中二病、黒間勇人(くろまゆうと)がインスピレーションのままに落書きした魔法陣から喚びだされたのは、まさかの最強龍王で…(？)さらに勇人は、3000年間も封印されていたさみしがりの邪龍ちゃんと、わけあって友達になることに…！！
description.ru: Юуто Курома, 14-летний парень с буйным воображением и синдромом восьмиклассника, случайно призывает Короля Драконов, нарисовав волшебный круг просто так, ради забавы. Да-да, это сработало. И как будто этого мало, по воле судьбы он знакомится с одинокой злой драконихой, которую запечатали ещё три тысячи лет назад. Теперь, сам того не ожидая, Юуто становится ключом к спасению мира. Вопрос только... выдержит ли мир такую «помощь»?
description.pt-br:
Yuuto Kuroma, um garoto de 14 anos com um sério caso de chuunibyou, acaba invocando acidentalmente o supremo Rei dos Dragões usando um círculo mágico que ele rabiscou só por diversão... (Sério mesmo?!)

Como se não bastasse, por conta de certas circunstâncias, Yuuto acaba fazendo amizade com uma solitária garota dragão maligna que estava selada há 3000 anos…!

Agora, o destino do mundo está casualmente nas mãos de um garoto completamente desprevenido!

description.en:
Although Eugene was blessed with an extraordinary talent for defensive magic, he had no talent for offensive magic. He is ridiculed as incompetent by those around him and enrolls in a magic academy to escape. However, his "useless" defensive magic came in handy there, and as expected, he was assigned to take care of the beautiful Demon King Erinyes, who once ruled the world...!?
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://j-novel.club/series/zero-damage-sword-saint-i-enrolled-in-a-magic-school-and-wound-up-in-a-contract-with-the-demon-queen)
description.ja: 魔法剣士に憧れていた少年ユージンには『攻撃魔法』の才能が皆無だった。そのことで周囲からは無能と揶揄され、夢を諦め逃げるように魔法学園へと転入。しかし、彼には欠損を補って余りある桁外れの『防御魔法』の才能があり――！？その才能を見込まれ、学園に封印されているかつて世界を統べた魔王エリーニュスと邂逅。なんとお世話係を任されて……？
description.es-la: Eugene procede de una familia de famosos espadachines, pero es tachado de "espadachín defectuoso" Que a pesar de poseer extraordinarias habilidades defensivas su poder ofensivo es basura. Abandona su país y se matricula en la principal escuela del continente, la Academia de Magia. En la academia, le piden a Eugene que vaya a lo más profundo de la prisión sellada, donde se se encuentran criaturas míticas y él es el único al que no afecta el miasma que estas desprenden. Sellado en las profundidades más oscuras de la prisión, donde incluso los más grandes magos de todos los tiempos caen de rodillas en el camino, se encuentra a la legendaria Rey Demonio Erinyes, que una vez gobernó el continente. Eugene llega fácilmente hasta ella, y ¿Parece que es el único que puede hacer un contrato con la Rey Demonio...? Una historia fantástica de otro mundo en la que un espadachín caído que se ha hecho con el poder del Rey Demonio ¡se convierte en el santo de la espada más fuerte! ¡Una historia que transcurre en el mismo universo de Shinja Zero Megami!

description.en: While you were admiring the girl in the next seat, she might be eyeing you up, too...?
description.fr:
Ikezawa, un des beaux gosses de son lycée, profite de sa position au sein de celui-ci pour se permettre d’être très taquin avec la gent féminine qui l’entoure. Cette réputation de pervers ne semble pas lui déranger, mais quelque chose le dérange réellement depuis peu. 

En effet, ce qui semblait être sa nouvelle proie, une jolie jeune fille du nom d’Eguchi, se révèle être une véritable perverse des beaux gosses, adorant taquiner ces derniers. Et notamment ce chère Ikezawa, qui n’a pas l’habitude qu’on le prenne à revers sur ses ambitions des plus perverses.

Son quotidien désormais chamboulé, comment va-t-il s’en sortir face à son némésis féminin ? Qui appréciera autant lui montrer ses charmes, dés plus dissimulés, que les siennes, et tout cela en public et sans gêne, bien entendu !
description.ja: 主人公の池沢くんは、同じクラスの美少女・江口さんのことを「そういう目」で見ている。しかし実は、江口さんも「そういう目」で池沢くんのことを見ていて！？チラ見えする筋肉、汗ばむ肌、髪の香り…互いに興味津々な2人の「下心」から始まる純愛ラブコメ！好きな人のなら、臭いも汗も×××も…全部好き。
description.uk: Не дивись на мене так! Історія про двох хтивих людей...
description.pt-br: Enquanto você admirava a garota no assento ao lado, ela pode estar de olho em você também...? Um novo tipo de comédia de amor puro de curta duração "vizinhança"!

altTitles.ja: １１番目のねこはねね

altTitles.en: The 11th Cat is Nene

altTitles.pt-br: Nene é a 11ª

description.en:
In the land of the cat people, it is a serious crime for outsiders to enter without permission. However, Nene, a mouse-girl, has managed to sneak into the country with a mysterious goal. In the meantime, Nene finds work at the Rai Rai Teahouse. Working alongside beautiful cat-girls, she struggles to learn how to "be a cat" from her senpais.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
description.ja:
耳をとがらせて、嘘のしっぽを装着して。小さな小さなネズミのネネは、今日から「ネコ」のフリをします！

ネズミだけが棲む「子ノ島」から憧れの「猫人國」へ密入国したネネ。ネコとして働き始めたネネを待っていたのは喫茶「雷雷茶楼」の10人のお姐さんネコたち！鋭かったり、色っぽかったり、意地悪だったり――ネコとの生活は、ネネにとって刺激＆波乱＆ときめきの連続。さあ、「危険でかわいい潜入生活」、はじまりはじまり！
description.pt-br: Na terra do povo-gato, é um crime grave que estrangeiros entrem sem permissão. No entanto, Nene, uma garota-rato, conseguiu se infiltrar no país com um objetivo misterioso. Enquanto isso, Nene encontra trabalho na Casa de Chá Rai Rai. Trabalhando ao lado de belas garotas-gato, ela se esforça para aprender com suas senpais como “ser uma gata”.

altTitles.es-la: Ella parece estar coqueteando conmigo

altTitles.vi: Cô Ấy Dường Như Đang Tán Tỉnh Tôi

Tā Hǎo Xiàng Zài Liāo Wǒ

altTitles.en: She Seems To Be Flirting With Me
She Seems To Be Teasing Me

description.en:
Yu Chaoyan, who became wildly popular with her performance in Black and Red, is as well known for her various rumors as she is for her fame. However, in reality, she is just a girl with a poisonous mouth. Recently, Yu Chaoyan was angered by a male actor's linked publicity stunts, and in a fit of rage, she powerfully challenged him on live cameras:

"If this world only had this man, I would rather date a woman"

This bold statement immediately exploded into the hot polls and caused a huge uproar. As a result of this, Yu Chaoyan was attacked in the parking lot by the male actor's fanatical fans who were lying in wait. At the moment of danger, Yu Chaoyan was heroically saved by Yin Zhou, who entered by mistake after taking the wrong path…
description.es-la: Yu Chaoyan, que se hizo famoso con la ruta negra y roja, tiene varios escándalos. Y es tan conocida como su fama. Sin embargo, en realidad, ella es simplemente una buena persona. Recientemente, Yu Chaoyan estaba molesto por la manipulación de cierta estrella masculina de atarlo para publicidad. Enojado, habló de manera dominante frente a la cámara en vivo: Si fuera el único hombre que quedaba en el mundo, entonces preferiría tener sexo con una mujer, ademas de que la Señorita Yu tiene bastante momentos dificiles pero ahora que pasara cuando conozca a Zhou Yi (una mujer fuera de lo común) quien se convertirá en su salvadora.

altTitles.ja: 異世界ありがとう
Thank you for another world

altTitles.en: Thank You, Isekai!
Thank You, Other World

description.en:
“Listen up, right now, there's a super important and urgent question! …Am I cute?”

Chiba and Shiina, a pair of single otaku males around 30 meet during a high school reunion! Shortly after hitting it off with each other, they're thrown into one misfortune after another, and before they know it… they've been reincarnated as pretty babes in another world!
description.ja:
すべての異世界にありがとう―――

チート、無双、ハーレム、俺TUEEE　……異世界でなら、夢を叶えることができる。異世界でなら、現世の鬱憤を晴らせる。異世界でなら、主人公になれる。そうした欲望に応えるべく、いまや異世界の数は10万をゆうに超えた。ここにまた一つの新しい異世界が生まれた。同窓会で知り合ったばかりのアラサーオタク男性二人が転生した。一人はお調子者で、一人はクールな感じ。二人はこの異世界を―――　楽しむことに決めた。RPGゲームにおいて、魔王を倒すことではなく、魔王を倒しにいく旅そのものを楽しむのと同じように。二人はもしかしたら魔王を倒しに行きさえしないかもしれない。それでも構わないはずだ。友達と一緒に知らない世界を旅する楽しさより優先されるべきことなんてないんだから。

title.ja-ro: Osananajimi to no Yakusoku wo Hatasu Tame ni Hyakunen Shugyo Shita Rouyuusha, Nokori no Jumyou de Maou wo Utsu

altTitles.ja: 幼馴染との約束を果たすために百年修行した老勇者、残りの寿命で魔王を討つ

altTitles.id: Demi Menepati Janji kepada Teman Masa Kecilnya, Seorang Pahlawan Tua yang Berlatih Selama Seratus Tahun Menaklukkan Raja Iblis dengan Sisa Umurnya

altTitles.en: To Fulfill a Promise to His Childhood Friend, the Old Hero Who Trained for a Hundred Years Defeats the Demon King with His Remaining Lifespan

description.en: Berg, whose parents were killed by demons, sets out on a journey to defeat the Demon King. On the night his village was attacked, he promised his childhood friend that he would slay the Demon King. To fulfill that promise, he secluded himself in the mountains and trained relentlessly. One hundred years later, now 110 years old and armed with overwhelmingly powerful punches, Berg finally descends from the mountain. On his way to the Demon King, he encounters Eruruna, an elven swordswoman fighting against the demons...
description.id: Berg, yang kehilangan ayah dan ibunya di tangan para iblis, memulai perjalanan untuk mengalahkan Raja Iblis. Pada malam saat desanya diserang, ia berjanji kepada teman masa kecilnya bahwa ia akan menaklukkan Raja Iblis. Demi memenuhi janji itu, Berg mengasingkan diri di pegunungan dan berlatih tanpa henti. Seratus tahun kemudian, setelah usianya mencapai 110 tahun dan menguasai pukulan dengan kekuatan yang luar biasa, ia akhirnya turun gunung. Dalam perjalanannya menuju Raja Iblis, Berg bertemu dengan Eruruna, seorang pendekar pedang elf yang sedang bertarung melawan para iblis...
description.ja: 魔族に父と母を殺されたベルグの魔王打倒の旅を描く。魔族に村を襲われた夜、幼なじみの少女に魔王を倒すと約束したベルグは修業のために山にこもる。それから100年後、110歳になるまで修業に明け暮れ、とてつもない威力の拳撃を身に付けたベルグはついに下山。魔王のもとに向かう道中で、魔族と戦うエルフの剣士・エルルナと出会って……。

altTitles.ja: 血海のノア

altTitles.en: Noah of the Blood Sea

description.en: When a family of three book passage on a luxury liner they soon realize that the glamourous cruise ship is nothing but a facade as a series of mysterious killings spread throughout the ship. With the sea offering no escape, how will they survive?
description.ja: 豪華客船に乗り込んだ、あかり達一家三人。「楽しい国内ツアー」という触れ込みだったこの旅行は、実は吸血鬼たちが支配する、地獄への片道切符だった――。何処にも逃げ場のない孤立した海上で、一人、また一人と乗客が殺されていく――。

altTitles.ja: メアヘイム

altTitles.en: Meaheim

description.en:
Rotten fruit returns to the branch, and gold drips down like water, A land where events beyond reason occur, a land known as Meichi (Underworld) that easily claims the lives of those who dare to enter. The scholar Ren arrives in this godforsaken land to save his sick younger brother. Together with the guide Tobia, Ren embarks on a perilous journey to obtain the Panacea, an ancient relic of Meichi.
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/meaheim)
description.ja:
異形の存在が蠢き、踏み入るものの命を容易に奪う土地、“冥地”。死の危険と引き換えに、この世ならざる秘宝を手に入れるため人々はこの地を訪れる。学者のレンは冥地に存在する“万能薬”を手に入れるべく、案内人のトビアと共に命懸けの旅に出ることに。しかしそこでレンを待っていたのは、人智を超えた不条理の数々だった。

「いいと言うまで、絶対に目を開けるな」

案内人の言葉だけを頼りに、レンは愛する家族を救うため、この呪われた土地からの生還を目指すが――。

title.ja-ro: Shangri-La Frontier ~Kusoge Hunter, Kami-gee ni Idoman to su~

altTitles.ja: シャングリラ・フロンティア～クソゲーハンター、神ゲーに挑まんとす～

altTitles.en: Shangri-La Frontier: From Trash-Game Hunter to God-Tier Game Master!

altTitles.zh-hk: 香格里拉・開拓異境～糞作獵手挑戰神作～

altTitles.pt-br: Shangri-La Frontier - o caçador de jogos ruins experimenta um jogo Divino.

altTitles.ru: Рубеж Шангри-Ла: любитель игрошлака бросает вызов топ игре

altTitles.vi: Shangri-La Frontier ~ Thợ săn game rác thách thức game thánh

description.en:
Second-year high school student Rakuro Hizutome loves nothing more than finding so-called "trash games" and beating the crap out of them. When he decides to change things up by playing a new, "god-tier" VR game known as Shangri-La Frontier (aka. SLF), he does what he does best: min-maxes, skips the prologue, and jumps straight into action! Rakuro may be a seasoned gamer, but a meeting with an old rival will change the fate of every SLF player forever.

Clad in nothing but shorts and a bird mask, Rakuro (player name: Sunraku) launches into the world of SLF. Things are going well at first as he takes down a goblin, a bunny, and even a python. But then Sunraku comes up against a huge, hard-hitting wolf known as Lycagon the Nightslayer. Will Sunraku's years of "trash game" experience be enough, or is he about to suffer a rude awakening just a few hours into his SLF adventure?
description.ja: “クソゲー”をこよなく愛する男・陽務楽郎。彼が次に挑んだのは、総プレイヤー数３０００万人の“神ゲー”『シャングリラ・フロンティア』だった！集う仲間、広がる世界。そして“宿敵”との出会いが、彼の、全てのプレイヤーの運命を変えていく！！
description.pt:
A adaptação cômica do romance superpopular de Syosetu Ni Narou.  
  
Hizutome Rakurou adora jogos de merda. Seu próximo desafio é Shangri-la Frontier, o jogo divino com uma base de jogadores total de 30.000.000. Reunindo companheiros (ralé) em um mundo expansivo e encontrando velhos inimigos pelo caminho, ele mudará o destino de cada jogador.
description.ru: Главный герой истории — лидер таблиц рейтинга в посредственных малоизвестных VR-играх (так называемый «игрошлак») которые, тем не менее, полностью его устраивают. Но однажды он решается бросить вызов сверхпопулярной игре с 30 миллионами активных пользователей под названием «Shangri-La Frontier». Адаптация суперпопулярного романа из "Shousetsuka ni Narou".
description.vi:
Theo ước tính, nếu tồn tại 100 game thánh thì cũng có đến 1000 game rác.
Bug, lỗi, texture vỡ nát, kịch bản đầy mâu thuẫn... Tất thảy những thứ đó khiến cho những người chơi không khỏi chán nản và từ bỏ.

Hitozume Rakuro là một thiếu niên cuồng nhiệt đam mê với những tựa game rác, vì một lý do nào đó mà quyết định thử sức với một con game thánh được cả thế giới công nhận.
Từ đó, cả thế giới game lẫn thế giới thực xoay quanh cậu dần bắt đầu thay đổi. Nhưng dù vậy, cậu vẫn luôn run sợ trước độ khủng khiếp của con game thánh này.

[Tỷ lệ đụng độ quái trong game thánh sao lại có thể vô lí thế này......? ]
description.pt-br:
O estudante do segundo ano do ensino médio, Rakuro Hizutome, adora encontrar os chamados “jogos ruins” e dar uma surra neles. Quando ele decide mudar as coisas jogando um novo jogo de realidade virtual de “nível divino” conhecido como Shangri-La Frontier (também conhecido como SLF), ele faz o que faz de melhor: min-maxes, pula o prólogo e pula direto para Ação! Rakuro pode ser um jogador experiente, mas um encontro com um antigo rival mudará para sempre o destino de cada jogador SLF.

Vestido apenas com shorts e uma máscara de pássaro, Rakuro (nome do jogador: Sunraku) se lança no mundo do SLF. As coisas vão bem no início, quando ele derruba um duende, um coelho e até uma píton. Mas então Sunraku se depara com um lobo enorme e contundente conhecido como Lycagon, o Matador da Noite. Os anos de experiência em “jogos ruins” de Sunraku serão suficientes ou ele está prestes a sofrer um rude despertar apenas algumas horas em sua aventura SLF?

description.en:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

---
I reincarnated as the heiress of a powerful conglomerate family in a novel. The problem is, this world is about to be destroyed by monstrous viruses.

With nothing but money to spare, I quickly bought a mansion in the countryside to build a shelter to escape the monsters… But the world ended far sooner than I had anticipated. Damn it!  

=
On top of that, somehow, the male leads ended up trapped in my house with me. And these guys don’t seem to have any intention of leaving. Why do they look like they have no plans to go to the female lead?

“Who exactly are you?”

“You seem like someone who knew the world was going to end beforehand.”

They were full of questions about me, but I couldn’t answer them. They wouldn’t believe me anyway. Right now, all I see them as is a good source of labor.

“Alright, let’s work. You need to earn your keep for what you eat!”

If I can find the cure for the virus causing the apocalypse, this hellish time will finally end. So, until then, I’ll make use of the male leads and hang on!

=
But one problem has come up. It turns out that this old mansion I purchased is far more suspicious than I thought. What on earth is happening in my house?
description.fr: Cherry Sinclair est une riche héritière dont le quotidien consiste à dépenser sa fortune… Jusqu’au jour où elle se souvient qu’elle est morte dans un accident de voiture et s’est réincarnée dans un roman d’amour post-apocalyptique. Et elle n'a que quelques semaines pour se préparer à faire face à la fin du monde. Il lui faut un abri, à manger et des armes pour faire face aux infectés. Et c’est le moment que choisit le frère de l’héroïne pour la soupçonner d’un trafic d’armes...
description.id: Aku bereinkarnasi sebagai pewaris sebuah konglomerat dalam novel tersebut. Namun, ada masalah, dunia ini akan dihancurkan oleh monster virus. Yang tersisa hanya uang, aku harus segera membeli tanah di pedesaan dan membangun tempat perlindungan untuk menghindari monster... Dunia runtuh jauh lebih cepat dari yang kukira, sial!" Dan entah bagaimana, bahkan para tokoh utama pria terperangkap bersamaku di rumahku. Tapi sepertinya kedua orang ini tidak mau pergi. Kenapa rasanya seolah-olah kalian tidak berniat untuk pergi ke tokoh utama wanita? "Apa-apaan kamu ini?" "Kurasa rasa dia tahu tentang kenyataan bahwa dunia akan hancur." Mereka punya banyak pertanyaan untukku, tapi aku tidak bisa menjawabnya. Lagipula, kalian juga tidak akan percayaku, kan? Sekarang, di mataku, mereka hanya terlihat seperti sumber daya tenaga yang berguna. "Sekarang ayo kita mulai bekerja, bayar sebanyak yang kamu makan!" Kalau kita berhasil menemukan obat untuk virus, penyebab kehancuran dunia, masa-masa neraka kita akan berakhir. Jadi, ayo manfaatkan para tokoh utama pria sampai saat itu dan bertahanlah! Tapi ada satu masalah. Rumah tua yangki beli ternyata cukup mencurigakan. Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi di rumahku?
description.ko:
소설 속 대재벌가의 상속녀로 환생했다.
문제는 이 세계가 바이러스 괴물로 인해 곧 멸망 예정이라는 거.

남는 건 돈뿐이겠다, 얼른 시골에 저택을 매입해서 괴물을 피할 대피소를 만들고 있었는데...
내 예상보다 훨씬 빠르게 세상이 멸망하고 말았다, XX!

=
게다가 어쩌다 보니 남주들까지 우리 집에 함께 갇혀버렸다.
그런데 이놈들이 우리 집에서 나갈 생각을 안 한다.
왜 다들 여주한테 갈 생각조차 없어 보이는 거야?

“너 대체 정체가 뭐야?” 
“세상이 멸망할 걸 미리 알고 있었던 사람 같습니다.” 

그들은 내게 궁금한 게 많았지만 답해줄 수 없었다. 어차피 안 믿을 거잖아?
지금 내 눈에 그들은 그저 좋은 노동력 자원으로 보일 뿐이다.

“이제 일합시다. 먹은 만큼 밥값 하세요!” 

세계 멸망의 원인인 바이러스의 치료제만 찾으면 이 지옥 같은 시간도 끝이다. 
그러니까 그때까지만 남주들을 굴리며 버티자! 

=
그런데 한 가지 문제가 생겼다.
내가 매입한 이 오래된 저택이 알고 보니 상당히 수상쩍다는 사실이다.
우리 집에서 대체 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거지?
description.ru:
В романе я перевоплотилась в наследницу крупного конгломерата. Проблема в том, что этот мир вот-вот будет уничтожен монстрами. Все, что у меня осталось, это деньги. Поэтому я быстро купила особняк в сельской местности и построила убежище, чтобы избежать монстров... Мир начал рушиться гораздо быстрее, чем я ожидала.
Более того, главные мужские герои оказались вместе со мной в доме. Но эти ребята не хотят покидать наш дома.
"Почему ты неожиданно уехала?" "Кто ты такая?" "Кажется, ты заранее знала о конце света."
У них было много вопросов ко мне, но я не могла дать на них ответ. Они все равно не поверят мне, правда? Сейчас в моих глазах они выглядят как бесплатная рабочая сила.
"Теперь приступим к работе! Платите за то, что вы едите!"
Если мы сможем найти лекарство от вируса, вызывающего разрушение мира, это адское время закончится. Так что до тех пор давайте держаться вместе.
Но возникла проблема. Оказывается, этот старый особняк, который я купила, весьма подозрительный. Что, черт возьми, происходит в моем доме?
description.uk:
Вона переродилась у роман, ставши донькою заможного магната. І все б нічого, але є одна мала проблема. Світ ось-ось буде знищений мутованими чудовиськами.

Усе, на що можна було покладатися – це гроші. Тож я швиденько придбала маєток за містом, облаштувавши собі притулок, щоб уникнути нападу монстрів. Але от курва, катастрофа сталася набагато швидше, ніж очікувалося!..

Якимось чином навіть головні герої опинилися у моєму маєточку. Та й здається, ці навіжені й наміру звідси носа совати не мають.
І чому, на диво, вони виглядають так, ніби навіть не бажають поцікавитися як там справи у головної героїні?!

«Хто ти така, чорт забирай?»
«Гадаю, вона знала, що незабаром настане кінець світу.»

Головні герої мали багато запитань, але я не могла на них відповісти. Усе одно не повірили б, правда ж? Тож, у моїх очах, вони проста лиш чудова рабська сила.

«А тепер до роботи. Їжмо, скільки влізе!»

Якщо знайти ліки від вірусу, який є причиною світової катастрофи, це божевілля скінчиться. Але срати я на подібне хтіла, тож просто почекаю на решту світу, сидячи у своєму маєтку та використовуючи головних героїв аби вижити!

Однак, є проблемка. З'ясувалося, що у будинку, який я придбала, кояться дивні речі. Ну що за чортівня?!

description.en:
High school student Misumi Makoto is called into a fantasy world by the god Tsukuyomi, in order to be a hero. However, powerful others in this world aren't as thrilled to have him there, and they kick him to the edge of the world just as Tsukuyomi declares that he must leave Makoto to find his own way. Now it's up to Makoto to find his own way!
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://hanashi.media/tsukimichi-moonlit-fantasy/)
description.fr:
Makoto Misumi, lycéen japonais de 17 ans de petite taille et vice président du club de kyūdō de son école, se fait envoyer soudainement dans un autre monde par le dieu Tsukuyomi, qui lui apprend que ses parents sont originaires de celui-ci et qu'ils ont conclu un pacte avec la déesse locale pour être envoyé au Japon.

Mais la dite déesse le trouve trop laid pour être un héros dans la guerre entre humains et démons qui déchire son monde et le lâche littéralement dans les confins de celui-ci avec seulement la capacité de comprendre les langues des êtres non-humains. Tsukuyomi intervient et lui donne une partie de sa force.

Makoto rencontrera Ema une orc qui sera sa première amie et fera de Shin, une dragonne qui se métamorphosera en jolie femme, son premier serviteur. Celle-ci voit avec le pouvoir de Makoto un de ses pouvoirs devenir un "autre espace" qui accueillera au fil des rencontres dans ce monde de magie et d'épée de nombreuses personnes.
description.ja: 主人公・深澄真（みすみ・まこと）はごく普通の高校生……だったはずが、両親の都合で異世界へ召喚されることに。しかもその世界の唯一神である女神に「顔が不細工」と罵られ、問答無用で最果ての荒野に飛ばされてしまう。人の温もりを求めて荒野をさまよう真だが、出会うのはなぜか人外ばかり。ようやく仲間にした美女ふたりも、元竜に元巨大蜘蛛というクセ者ぞろい。とことん不運、されどチートな真の異世界珍道中のゆくえは――！？
description.pt-br: O estudante Misumi Makoto é invocado para outro mundo, para ser o herói. Mas a Deusa do outro mundo não gosta desse herói, por isso o envia para o fim do mundo. Agora Makoto tem de encontrar o seu próprio caminho nesse novo mundo de fantasia!

description.en:
Civilization is dead, but Chito and Yuuri are still alive. 
So they hop aboard their Kettenkrad motorbike and aimlessly wander the ruins of the world they once knew. 
Day after hopeless day, they look for their next meal and fuel for their ride. 
But as long as they are together, even an existence as bleak as theirs has a ray or two of sunshine in it, 
whether they're sucking down their fill of soup or hunting for machine parts to tinker with. 
The experiences and feelings these two girls share in a world full of nothing give them something to live for…  
  
---
- **Won the Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2019**
description.id:
Peradaban tewas, tapi Chito dan Yuuri masih hidup. Jadi mereka naik sepeda motor Kettenkrad tersayang mereka dan bermondar-mandir tanpa tujuan reruntuhan dunia yang mereka dulu kenal. Hari demi hari tanpa harapan, mereka mencari makanan berikut mereka dan bensin untuk kendaraan mereka. Tapi selama mereka berdua bersama, bahkan kehidupan seguram mereka masih ada sedikit kesenangan di dalamnya, entah minum sup entah mencari bagian-bagian mesin untuk menggerumit. Untuk dua putri di dalam dunia kosong, pengalaman dan perasaan keduanya bersama ada memberi mereka alasan untuk hidup...

- Pemenang Penghargaan Seiun (Nebula) Jepang dalam kategori Komik/Manga terbaik di 2019.
description.ru:
Мир будущего. Человеческая цивилизация достигла невероятного технологического прогресса и однажды построила себе гигантские многоуровневые города, в которых проживало огромное количество людей. Однако через какое-то время началась война, после которой человечество оказалось на грани вымирания.
Спустя много лет в одном из таких городов мы встречаем Тито и Юри. Эти две маленькие девочки изо дня в день путешествуют на своём модифицированном Kettenkrad в поисках пропитания и ресурсов.
Движимые желанием забраться на самую вершину этого опустевшего города-исполина, они постоянно сталкиваются со всё новыми и новыми загадочными сооружениями, памятниками истории и культуры и даже с некоторыми другими выжившими. Что же будет ждать их в конце этой длинной дороги?
description.uk: Дівчата Чіто та Юурі — певно, останні вцілілі після війни, що перетворила людську цивілізацію на руїну. Не маючи більше власного дому, дівчата блукають містом на гусеничному мотоциклі «Кеттенкрад», постійно шукаючи ресурси задля виживання. Утім, попри безпросвітне майбутнє, дівчата однаково знаходять способи розважити себе впродовж цієї меланхолійної подорожі.
description.pt-br: A civilização está morta, mas Chito e Yuuri ainda estão vivas. Então elas sobem a bordo de sua amada moto Kettenkrad e calmamente vagam pelas ruínas do mundo. Dia após dia sem esperança, elas procuram a próxima refeição e acumulam combustível para seguir em frente. Mas enquanto elas estiverem juntas, até uma existência tão sombria como esta tem um ou dois raios de sol a brilhar, mesmo que estejam tomando as últimas gotas de uma sopa ou à caça de peças para seu veículo se mexer. Para duas garotas em um mundo cheio de nada, as experiências e os sentimentos que compartilham são a sua força para viver.

description.ja: ２度目の結婚記念日。仕事を終えて帰宅した和光市路が目撃したのは見知らぬ男と交わる妻の姿だった──！住み慣れた我が家、幸福な日々、そして愛する人を失った和光だったが、そんな彼の前に現れたのは…！？
description.vi: Câu chuyện bắt đầu khi nhân vật chính, Wakou Ichiro về nhà sớm để kỷ niệm 2 năm ngày cưới với vợ mình. Nhưng bất ngờ khi mở cửa ra thì... Anh phát hiện vợ mình đang làm tình với người đàn ông khác. Cuộc hôn nhân dù ngắn nhưng cũng làm cuộc sống của anh thay đổi một lần nữa. Bất ngờ một cô gái xuất hiện trước mặt anh, câu truyện vừa hài vừa lứng sẽ bắt đầu?
description.es-la: La historia empieza con el protagonista, Wakou Ichiro, quien decida regresar temprano a casa del trabajo para celebrar su segundo aniversario con su esposa. Pero, cuando abre la puerta de su casa... ¡Se encuentra a su esposa siéndole infiel! A pesar de que matrimonio duró muy poco, su vida vuelve a cambiar cuando de repente, frente a él se aparece cierta mujer... ¡Así comienza una nueva historia, una nueva comedía erótica!

description.en: Jonak is on his way to find a fabled dragon god said to aid humans so that he can save the village that he comes from. Finally, as Jonak stands before the god, Adain, he asks only for Jonak's body in exchange. The dragon god known to many as a tragic and passionate has come to be quite high and mighty in attitude... and Jonak is now his mate...?!
description.es:
Con el fin de salvar su aldea natal, Jonark busca la ayuda del dios dragón, quien se dice que concede los deseos de los humanos. Sin embargo, Adan, el dios dragón, le exige a cambio al propio Jonark. A pesar de sentirse desconcertado por la actitud arrogante de Adan, muy distinta a la imagen benevolente que describen las leyendas, Jonark acepta sin dudar convertirse en el "compañero del dragón"... ¿¡!?
[Un dios dragón altivo × un joven huérfano y solitario]
description.fr: Jonak est en route pour trouver un dragon divin légendaire, censé venir en aide aux humains, afin de sauver le village d’où il vient. Mais lorsqu’il se tient enfin devant le dieu, Adain, celui-ci ne demande en échange rien d’autre que… le corps de Jonak. Le dieu-dragon, connu de tous comme une figure tragique et passionnée, se révèle en réalité hautain et orgueilleux… et Jonak est désormais son compagnon…?!
description.ja: 故郷の村を救うため、人間の願いを叶えてくれるという竜神に助けを求めたヨナーク。竜神・アダンはその対価としてヨナーク自身を要求してきた。慈悲深い神の伝承とは違うアダンの尊大な態度に戸惑ったものの、ヨナークは迷わず「竜の番」になることを了承して…！？

altTitles.ja: ジャヒー様はくじけない！

altTitles.fr: La Grande Jahy ne Perd Jamais

altTitles.vi: Jahy-sama sẽ không bỏ cuộc!

description.en:
Jahy-sama (pronounced jah-hee) is an existence to be feared and respected throughout the Demon Realm. Well, was. The (former) Demon Realm No. 2 is now busy with house chores and work... in the human realm! Her dinner is just beansprouts, and she can't afford anything except water at cafes, but she won't get discouraged!
___
**Note:**
Jahy's shirt says '魔界復興', which seems to translate to "Demon Realm Restoration".
description.ja: 魔界No.２のジャヒー様は、魔界中の誰もが恐れ敬う存在…だった。（元）魔界No.２のジャヒー様は…人間界では家事に、バイトに、大忙し！夕食がもやしオンリーでも、カフェで水しか頼めなくても、くじけちゃダメだっ！
description.ru: Джахи-сама - существо, которое боялись и уважали во всем демоническом мире. Ну, когда-то... Вторая по силе (прежде) мира демонов теперь занята домашними заботами и работой... в человеческом мире! Её ужин - одна фасоль, а в кафе она не может себе позволить ничего кроме воды, но её никогда не сломить!

altTitles.ja: キャッチャー・イン・ザ・ライム

description.en:
A yuri story about Takatsuji Satsuki, a shy depressed teenager who joins a rap battle club at her all-girls school as she tries to get out of her shell. Starts out with three main characters but later, a trans girl character joins the club as well.  
  
  
From Sexy Akiba Detectives:  
When shy, depressive, incredibly emo Takatsuji Satsuki enters high school, she’s determined to make a change in her life… so she ends up joining the school’s rap battle club… but will the obnoxious MC Ren and her best friend Anzu help her realise the fire vocalist that resides within her!?  
  
  
[Twitter](https://twitter.com/waki_ase)
I am from Egypt. I love drawing manga as a hobby. I am not good enough, but I am trying. Your comments and testimony motivate me to continue.

description.en: The sequel series to "Kinnikuman ii sei".     A new threat appears to defeat the Legends, known only as the 'Time Chojin'. These mysterious villains travel through time, in their quest to eradicate the Justice Chojin. If their plan succeeds, they will erase the New Generation from history and usher in a new era of evil domination over the humans.     The New Generation must travel through time to stop the Time Chojin.    In the process, they earn the distrust of the Legends. The ensuing conflict triggers the start of the 'Ultimate Chojin Tag Tournament', which will pit Legends against New Generation, and Justice Chojin vs Evil Chojin. The winners will determine the future of the planet as we know it and reign supreme over Earth.

altTitles.en: Parrot Punisher

altTitles.pt-br: Anjo da Guarda

description.en:
"Those with blood on their blades don't cross the Lower Yangtze."

No So-ha, the sole heir to the reputedly invincible Nine Flow Swordsmanship, lives a low-profile life with three sources of income: fishing, ferrying customers across the Lower Yangtze, and as a contract hitman for victims of injustice. Despite trying to stay away from the conflicts among martial arts factions, he finds himself taking up the most dangerous job of all: escorting to safety in Korea a girl who holds the missing part of the Sun Gun Gyung, a 1,500-year-old medical treatise written for Emperor Qin Shi Huang that is the key to achieving immortality.

A Korean xianxia webtoon about a blade-for-hire's adventure in Yuan China.
description.pt-br:
"Aqueles com sangue em suas lâminas não cruzam o Baixo Yangtzé."
No So-ha, único herdeiro da lendária e invencível Técnica das Nove Correntes da Espada, leva uma vida discreta com três fontes de renda: pesca, transporte de clientes pelo Baixo Yangtzé e como um assassino de aluguel contratado para vítimas de injustiça. Apesar de tentar se afastar dos conflitos entre as facções das artes marciais, ele acaba assumindo o trabalho mais perigoso de todos: escoltar com segurança até a Coreia uma garota que possui a parte perdida do Sun Gun Gyung, um tratado médico de 1.500 anos escrito para o Imperador Qin Shi Huang, a chave para alcançar a imortalidade.

description.en: She has the looks of a model that stands out from the crowd, and on top of that, she has a great personality, too. Daily life with such a sister must seem quite strange to other people.......?
description.es: Ella tiene un rostro que rivaliza con el de una modelo, un estilo sobresaliente y, además, una gran "personalidad". Él lleva una gran relación con hermana que ¿parece bastante extraña para los demás...? Esta es una comedia romántica sobre un hermano y una hermana que después de todo encajan "sin lugar a duda" ¡con la hermana más linda del mundo!
description.ja: モデル顔負けの顔立ちに、抜群のスタイル、おまけに性格も良い。そんな妹との仲良し生活は、他人から見るとかなりおかしく見えるようで……？

altTitles.ja: 人形峠

altTitles.en: Ningyou Pass

description.en: A group of high school students visit the inside of a mountain on an agricultural trip. While staying at a farmer's home, they learn the rural life. However, the village doesn't exist…? A shudder runs down everyone's spine as a lot of inexplicable events happen in the village, that now restricts entry. What are the high schoolers' fate?

altTitles.ja: ぶっ壊れ世界で死んだ時

altTitles.en: When I Die in a Broken World

description.en: The young man Shirabane thought as he was bitten by a zombie, "That's the best." His parents evaporated, he couldn't go to high school, and the young man was in despair every day when he was forced to collect debt. However, for some reason, he wakes up and remains conscious in a zombie state! In that case, let's go to the high school we couldn't go to, make zombie friends, and enjoy a second life!! Such a happy moment is fleeting, and he despairs of this world again. What will the young man find in this rotten world, and what will he leave behind when he dies again?
description.ja: シラバネ青年はゾンビに噛まれながら思った──、最高じゃん。親は蒸発、高校にも行けず、借金取りに追い立てられる毎日に青年は絶望していた。しかし、彼は何故か目が覚め、意識のあるままゾンビの状態に！？そんなら、行けなかった高校行って、ゾンビの友達なんか作ってセカンドライフ謳歌しようぜ！！そんな楽しいひと時もつかの間、彼は再びこの世に絶望する。この腐った世界で青年は何を見出し、再び死ぬとき何を遺すのか。

altTitles.es-la: Los peligros en mi corazón

altTitles.vi: Bóng Đen Trong Tim

altTitles.ja: 僕ヤバ

description.de:
Der Teenager Ichikawa Kyoutarou gehört zu den allerletzten auf seiner Schule. Neben seinen Bemühungen, Unterhaltungen mit einer bestimmten Klassenkameradin aufrechtzuerhalten, muss er sich außerdem noch dafür zusammenreißen, mörderische Dränge aus den Tiefen seiner Seele zu verbergen.

Eigentlich ist es aber eine niedliche Liebesgeschichte zwischen einem geistig gestörten Jungen und einer fröhlichen, leicht komisch, jedoch schönen Mädchen.
description.en:
Following Ichikawa Kyoutarou, a teenage boy belonging to the very bottom caste of his school, this work details his troubled interactions with a certain classmate, and his attempt to hide murderous impulses that find themselves in the darkest recesses of his soul. In reality, though, it's a sweet youth rom-com between a messed up boy and a bright, if somewhat strange, beautiful girl.
___
**Awards:**
- Won the 2020 Next Manga Award in the Web category.
- Was nominated for the 2020 and 2021 Manga Taishou Award.
- Won the top prize of the 2021 Tsutaya Comic Awards.

**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/boku__yaba)
description.ja: 学園カースト頂点の美少女・山田杏奈の殺害を妄想してはほくそ笑む、重度の中二病の陰キャ・市川京太郎。だが山田を観察する内に、京太郎が思う「底辺を見下す陽キャ」とは全然違うことに徐々に気づいていき…!? 陰キャ男子
description.ru: «Страшный психо-триллер», сосредоточенный на «тёмной стороне юности». История повествует о Киотаро Ичикаве — человеке, находящемся на самой низшей ступени в своей школе и скрывающем убийственный порыв, находящийся в самой глубине его души... на деле же, это милый ром-ком про странного мальчика и прекрасную, хоть и слегка странную, девушку.
description.es-la:
La historia trata sobre un joven llamado Kyotaro Ichikawa que sufre de un caso grave de “chūnibyō” y se divierte imaginando la muerte de una hermosa chica llamada Anna Yamada, quien está en la cima de la jerarquía social de la escuela. Sin embargo, mientras observa a Yamada, Kyotaro comienza a darse cuenta de que ella es muy diferente de lo que él pensaba.

 - Ganó el premio Tsugi ni Kuru Web Manga 2020.
- Fue nominado para el premio Manga Taisho en 2020 y 2021.
- Ganó el primer premio en los premios Tsutaya Comic de 2021.
description.pt-br:
Um "intenso thriller psicológico" centralizado no lado obscuro da adolescência. 

O mangá gira em torno de Kyoutaro Ichikawa, uma pessoa no fundo da hierarquia de sua escola, que esconde um impulso assassino no fundo de sua alma. Mas na realidade, é uma doce comédia romântica entre um garoto confuso e uma garota brilhante, embora um tanto estranha e bonita.

altTitles.en: Listening to the stars

altTitles.vi: Lắng Nghe Những Vì Sao

description.en: Having suffered several setbacks in her attempt to be a voice actor, Chi Yu no longer dares to bring up her hobby of dubbing in front of others. Instead, she covertly tunes in to voice drama broadcasts on Lily Radio. One day, during a public lecture at her university, she discovers that Yu Chen from the neighboring college shares a strikingly similar voice to the host of Lily Radio.

altTitles.en: Haimiya-Senpai is Scary But Cute

altTitles.pt-br: A Haimiya-senpai é Assustadoramente Fofa

altTitles.vi: Haimiya-Senpai vừa Đáng sợ lại vừa Đáng yêu

altTitles.pt-br: Haimiya Senpai é Assustadora e Fofa

altTitles.en: Haimiya-senpai is Cutie Scary

description.en:
At my high school, Haimiya-senpai is feared by all and considered too scary. This is apparently due to her intimidating appearance and blunt way of speaking... and those sparkling piercings! The long, gray wolf-cut hair! Even her Kansai accent is intimidating!!!
But for some reason, this scary senpai treats me kindly...?
As "scary" turns into "cute," this scary (heart-pounding) senpai rom-com begins!
description.fr:
Au lycée, tout le monde a peur de Haimiya. Elle a un regard perçant, parle sans détour, porte des piercings qui scintillent, et ses longs cheveux gris en *wolf cut* n'arrangent rien… Même son accent Kansai est intimidant !
 
Pourtant, pour une raison que j’ignore… elle est incroyablement gentille avec moi.
 
Ce qui était « effrayant » devient peu à peu… « adorable ». Voici une comédie romantique effroyablement mignonnequi commence !
description.ja: うちの高校にいる灰宮先輩は、怖いと恐れられている。 というのも、その強い見た目と歯に衣着せぬ言葉遣いが原因らしく… バチバチに開いたピアス！ 灰色のロングウルフカット！！ そして威圧感のある関西弁！！！ だけど、そんな怖い先輩がなぜか僕にだけは優しく接してくれて――!? ”怖い”が”かわいい”に変わっていく、 怖キュン先輩ラブコメ開幕です！
description.uk:
У моїй старшій школі Хаймію-семпай усі бояться і вважають її надто страшною. Мабуть, це пов'язано з її незвичною зовнішністю та прямолінійною манерою говорити... і цим блискучим пірсингом! Довгим сірим волоссям зі зачіскою wolf cut! Навіть її кансайський акцент лякає!!!

Але з якоїсь причини ця моторошна семпай ставиться до мене доброзичливо...?
Коли «лячно» перетворюється на «мило», починається ця страшна (від чого серце шалено б'ється) романтична комедія про семпай!
description.vi: Ở ngôi trường tôi theo học, mọi người ai cũng sợ hãi Haimiya-senpai bởi ngoại hình và cách ăn nói của chị ấy. Mái tóc xám dài kiểu wolf-cut! Ngay cả chất giọng Kansai của chị ấy cũng đáng sợ nữa!!! Nhưng không hiểu sao, đàn chị đáng sợ ấy lại đối xử rất tốt với tôi…?
description.pt-br:
Na minha escola, a Haimiya-senpai é temida por todos e considerada assustadora demais.
Aparentemente, isso se deve à sua aparência intimidadora e ao seu jeito direto de falar... e àqueles piercings brilhantes!
O cabelo longo, grisalho, em corte “wolf cut”!
Até mesmo o sotaque de Kansai dela é intimidador!!!
Mas, por alguma razão, essa senpai assustadora me trata com gentileza...?
À medida que o “assustadora” se transforma em “fofa”, começa esta comédia romântica de arrepiar o coração com a senpai assustadora!

altTitles.ja: かまくらBAKE猫倶楽部

altTitles.en: Kamakura Monster-Cat Club

description.en: There exists an old rumor relating to cats within the ancient capital of Kamakura... that if you go to the "Bakeneko Club", located somewhere in Kamakura, you can meet cats that have gone missing. Even today, people wander into "Kamakura Neko Club", where Maya and Gakuto work, relying on this rumor.
The story of a scarred girl named Amelia and how she slowly opens up.
