description.ja:
雪国から特使として、敵国である砂国に派遣された皇子のキオネ。
その実態は人質の立場であり、仕事も思うようにこなせないまま部屋に引きこもり鬱屈とした日々を送っていた。
しかし、そんなある夜に出会った砂国の姫のダリから唐突に、そして猛烈に求婚されて!?
人質皇子と落ちこぼれ姫様が二国を変える、宮廷奮闘ラブコメディ!
description.vi:
Hoàng tử Kione được phái từ Xứ tuyết đến Sa mạc quốc—vương quốc thù địch—với tư cách là một đặc sứ.
Thế nhưng, thực chất thân phận của chàng lại là một con tin. Không thể hoàn thành công việc như mong muốn, trải qua những chuỗi ngày u uất, giam mình trong phòng kín.
Nhưng rồi vào một đêm nọ, chàng bất ngờ gặp gỡ Dali, nàng công chúa của Sa mạc quốc, và đột nhiên nhận được lời đính hôn vô cùng mãnh liệt từ nàng !?
Cuộc chiến chốn cung đình đầy hài hước và lãng mạn của chàng hoàng tử con tin và nàng công chúa "kém cỏi", cặp đôi sẽ cùng nhau thay đổi vận mệnh của cả hai quốc gia !
Bộ Oneshot đình đám ngày nào đã được chuyển thể thành series!!!

Noa is My Senior, and My Friend.

description.cv:
Ҫитӗннӗ ҫыннӑн хурлӑ та тертлӗ пурнӑҫӗнче «туссем» кирлӗ.

Вӑйӑ кумппанийӗнче пулса пыракан халап хӑйӗн ӗҫӗнче тата ҫынсем хутшӑнвӗнче «виҫеллӗ» 23 ҫулти Уччукка Риххиттӑвӗ тата хӑйӗн ӗҫӗнче пӗтӗм вӑй паракан ӗҫчен 27 ҫулти Савуттуме Нуви тавра ҫаврӑнса тӑрать. Икӗ сӑнар, вӗсен пурнӑҫӗсем пӗр-пӗринпе ҫыхӑнмалла мар пек пулсан та, «туссем» пулса тӑраҫҫӗ...
Ҫапла пуҫланать те кӑшт ҫепӗҫ те кӑшт йывӑр ӳххисри «туссен» камичӗ!
description.en:
A bitter and painful adult's life needs "friends".  Set in a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), who is your everyday salaryman, and Noa Saotome (27), the ultimate career woman. Two characters whose lives aren't supposed to intersect become "friends" by chance.
___
**Links:** 
- [Alternative Raw](https://ynjn.jp/allEpisodeList/10427)
description.ja: 苦くて辛いオトナの人生にこそ、“ともだち”が必要だ。仕事も人付き合いも「ほどほど」が身上の“平熱さとり”大塚理人（２３）と、恋に仕事に全力過ぎる“限界バリキャリ”早乙女望愛（２７）。ゲーム会社の同僚であるふたりが、ひょんなことから「友達」に…！？
description.ru:
«Друзья» необходимы в горькой и мучительной жизни взрослого человека.

История, происходящая в игровой компании, разворачивается вокруг Рихито Оцуки (23 года), который «умерен» в своей работе и социальных взаимодействиях, и Ноа Саотомэ (27 лет), карьеристки, которая выкладывается на полную во всём, что делает. И эти два непересекающихся характера случайно становятся «друзьями»?.. И так начинается немного сладкая и тяжеловатая «офисно-дружеская» комедия!

---

**Links:** 
- [Alternative Raw (Ch15 Continue Here)](https://ynjn.jp/allEpisodeList/10427)
description.tr: Bir yetişkinin yorucu hayatında "arkadaşların" olması gerekir. Bir oyun geliştirme firmasında geçen bu hikâyede Rihito Otsuka (23), sıradan bir maaşlı çalışan, ve Noa Saotome (27), olabilecek en iyi kariyer kadını, ile tanışın. Hayatları kesişmemesi gereken bu iki karakter şans eseri "arkadaş" olurlar.
description.es-la:
La vida amarga y dolorosa de los adultos necesita amistades. Ambientado en una compañía de videojuegos, Rihito Otsuka, un oficinista de 23 años. Que es normal socializando y trabajando. Y Noa Saotome de 27, que lo da todo en todo lo que hace. Dos personaje que a priori no encajan... ¿Pueden ser amigos por casualidad? 
¡Comienza una dulce y pequeña pero pesada comedia sobre amigos de oficina!

description.en: Dangerous creatures known as “Gaichu” descend from outer space. A nonstop sci-fi battle thriller depicting split-second moments on the brink of death!
description.pt-br: As perigosas criaturas conhecidas como “Gaichu” chegam do espaço sideral. Um eletrizante thriller de batalhas sci-fi que retrata momentos em que a morte está sempre à espreita!

altTitles.ja: いただきます、は恋の味

description.en:
A high school boy's lunchbox is filled with excitement! A BL about young love between a picky eater and a cooking fanatic!　

Mizuno, a cooking fanatic, is so preoccupied about what other people eat that he even keeps a close eye on his classmates' lunches. He's particularly taken aback by the picky eater, Hashimoto, and worries that someday he'll get sick, and after a certain chain of events, Mizuno gets stuck with making Hashimoto's lunches for him! At first, Mizuno isn't crazy about the idea, but as he watches Hashimoto's face as he eats his perfectly balanced and nutritious packed lunches with gusto, Mizuno starts to enjoy his lunch time as well...

title.ja-ro: Isekai de Mizu no Dai Seirei Yattemasu

altTitles.ja: 異世界で水の大精霊やってます。

altTitles.en: I'm Working as the Great Water Spirit in Another World

description.en: When the laid-back high school student Saejima Nagi wakes up from a nap, he finds himself in a lake in another world!? After learning that he is the "Great Water Spirit" whose essence is the lake, Nagi uses the power that resides within him to heal those suffering from injuries and illnesses. One day, Nagi is led by a voice calling for help and is summoned by a boy. This encounter will greatly change Nagi's fate...
description.ja: のんびり屋の高校生・冴島凪（サエジマ ナギ）。ある日居眠りから目覚めると、異世界の湖になっていた！？自分が湖を本体とする「水の大精霊」になったと知り、怪我や病で苦しむ者たちを自らに宿る力で癒していく。やがてナギは助けを求める声に導かれ、ひとりの少年に召喚される。その出会いがナギの運命を大きく変えることになり――。

altTitles.ja: 俺の担当は怪物

altTitles.en: I'm in Charge of Monsters
My Ward is a Monster

altTitles.vi: Tôi phụ trách quái vật

description.en: Hananosuke Yamase, a struggling manga editor with no hits to his name, was fed up with Megumi Kojika, the talented author he had been keeping an eye on. Her problem? She was too close! Every time they met to discuss storyboards, she'd press herself against him, trying to seduce him. Hananosuke was constantly flustered by her, but one day he ended up taking her home! He almost crossed the line there, but then he discovered her true identity...!? His assigned author is a former beautiful prisoner who committed murder!?
description.ja: ヒット作が出ず、泣かず飛ばずの漫画編集 花之介は、才能溢れると見込んで目を掛けている担当作家 恵に辟易していた。それは彼女の距離が近すぎること！！ネームの打ち合わせをするたびに体を密着させて、こちらを誘惑してくる。しかし、花之介は彼女を拒む理由があった。担当だからではない、それは彼女は実の両親を惨殺した殺人鬼と知っているから――。果たして、元殺人鬼の美人作家の誘惑を跳ね除け、ヒット作を作ることができるのか！！

title.ja-ro: Jibun Shika Shiranai Kareshi no Ichi Men

altTitles.en: A Side of Him Only I Know

altTitles.ja: 自分しか知らない彼氏の一面

description.en:
My boyfriend is unbelievably beautiful.
He is kind to everyone. A serious, top-tier student.

…but there’s a cute side of him only I get to see.

———

Kanemori is the school’s flawless “prince”—handsome, elegant, and perfect at everything he does.
But in front of his boyfriend, Shikano… he turns into a total sweetheart?!

altTitles.ja: 絶対悪の怪物

altTitles.en: Monster of Absolute Evil

description.en: "The Fukurogi Incident" — a serial murder case in which 23 murderers met their end at the hands of an active police officer, Fukurogi Nodoka. Nodoka, presumed dead after her execution, awakens to find herself informed by a mysterious girl, Lassey, that she's been made to participate in a battle royale between resurrected heinous murderers. Nodoka, driven by the desire to prevent further atrocities by these resurrected criminals and eliminate their kind from the world, plunges into this distasteful game.
description.ja: 『梟木事件』ーー現職警察官・梟木和によって、２３人の殺人犯が犠牲となった連続殺人事件。死刑を執行されたはずの和が目を覚ますと、謎の少女・レシィーによって、『復活した凶悪殺人犯同士のバトルロイヤル』の参加者になったことを告げられる。和は復活した凶悪犯たちの蛮行の阻止、そして社会からの殺人犯の殲滅を目指し、この悪趣味な“ゲーム”に身を投じていく。

altTitles.en: Loser Fox Ah Ju

description.en: This is the life story of a cute and dumb fox.
description.ru: История о взрослении милого глупого лиса.

altTitles.es: La Leyenda de los Héroes de la Galaxia

altTitles.ja: 銀河英雄伝説

altTitles.en: Legend of the Galactic Heroes

description.en:
New adaptation of the 1980s novel series.

Five hundred years ago, Rudolf von Goldenbaum united the disparate governments of humankind and established a mighty human empire, a tribute to his own greatness that stretched across the galaxy. Demanding loyalty and discipline, Rudolf created an order designed to long outlast his own rule; but all human works fade in time. Today, the decaying empire faces the threat of the Free Planets Alliance and military leaders on both sides jockey for power in the face of a seemingly inevitable conflict. On the side of the empire, the young general Reinhard von Lohengramm sees war as an opportunity, and the empire as soft clay ready for his own sculpting. On the side of the alliance, would-be historian Yang Wen-li would like nothing better than to live out his days in peace - but times of war have little use for men who waste their days studying the mistakes of the past. Circumstances will make heroes and villains of both these men, as they write new history one blood-splattered page at a time.
  


---
description.ru:
Новая экранизация романа.  
История человечества всегда была историей войн, во все времена, во все эпохи. И во все эпохи находятся люди, оставляющие след в истории, чьи имена выжжены на её скрижалях. Этих людей называют героями.  
В третьем тысячелетии, когда люди давно переселились с Земли на просторы Галактики, между абсолютной монархией Галактический Рейх и республикой Союз Свободных Планет уже 150 лет продолжается война. И на озарённом пламенем войны небосклоне зажигаются звёзды героев, судьба которых - изменить мир.

altTitles.ja: ゆーあーすらっがー

altTitles.en: You are a Slugger

altTitles.es-la: Eres una gran bateadora

description.en: Uonuma Wako is a high school girl aiming to become a professional baseball player. A genius slugger with a powerful swing as her weapon... but in everyday life, she's a surprisingly clumsy and inept girl. Even though her days are full of trouble, supported by her childhood friend Taiji and those around her, Wako continues to move forward with all her might.
description.ja: プロ野球選手を目指す女子高生・魚沼ワコ。豪快なスイングを武器にする天才スラッガー‥‥だけど日常生活は、びっくりするほど不器用で要領の悪いポンコツ少女。トラブルだらけの毎日でも、幼なじみのタイジや周囲の人たちに支えられながらワコは今日も全力でまっすぐ前へ進んでいく。
description.es-la:
Wako Uonuma es una estudiante de preparatoria que sueña con ser jugadora profesional de béisbol. Es una bateadora prodigiosa cuya mejor arma es su swing explosivo... Sin embargo, en su vida diaria es una chica torpe y despistada que sorprende por su falta de habilidad.

A pesar de que sus días están llenos de problemas, apoyada por su amigo de la infancia Taiji y las personas que la rodean, Wako sigue avanzando hoy también con todas sus fuerzas. Esa forma de ser de Wako termina conmoviendo incluso los corazones de quienes la rodean... ¡Una historia de béisbol en plena juventud!

altTitles.ja: 太陽よりも眩しい星

altTitles.en: A Star Brighter Than the Sun

altTitles.vi: Ngôi Sao Toả Sáng Hơn Mặt Trời

description.en: Sae Iwata is a girl who is stronger than average. Her childhood friend who was small and weak when they were little, grew into a handsome man. She thought that they had drifted apart, but they were reunited for the first time in a long time at the last athletic festival in middle school...? A refreshing story begins!
description.ru: Саэ Ивата всегда выглядела крупнее и сильнее сверстниц. А её друг детства, Коки Камиширо, был маленьким и слабым. Впервые за долгое время они встретились на последнем спортивном фестивале средней школы... Саэ осознала, что Коки вырос в высокого привлекательного парня и что у неё имеются к нему чувства. Оказывается, у Коки тоже есть романтический интерес. Вопрос в том, к кому..?

altTitles.ja: ライスショルダー

description.en: The story revolves around a 202-pound, 18-year old girl named Okome Akino (whose name is a pun of "autumn rice"). After Okome enters a sumo match and wins against a male amateur fighter by a landslide, a trainer named Akane scouts her, and she enters the world of women's boxing.

title.ja-ro: Ashita no Teki to Kyou no Akushu o

altTitles.ja: 明日の敵と今日の握手を

altTitles.en: Shake Hands with Tomorrow's Enemies Today

description.en:
If you get it wrong, it's a world war! ! A world where steamer roar and fleets fly across the sky. A monster-type boss and a new pair of hard-working female officers go to an enemy country as military attache. This is a complete diplomatic war story where the nation's trend is at stake!
___
**Additional Sites:**
- [Official X](https://x.com/asu_teki)
description.ja: ドラゴンフライ皇国は、世界に覇を唱える『皇帝同盟』と結ぶべきだという主張の『艦隊派』、世界の現状維持を望む『協商』との友好関係を続けるべきだ、とする『条約派』の2つに分かれ内部対立を深めていた。『皇帝同盟』へ属するべき、バスに乗り遅れるな。という風向きが強くなる中、ユトランド上空の戦争で大きく戦況が変わる。結果、新品中尉・アメリアは関係が悪くなりつつある『協商』国家ブレタニケに『条約派』の正論モンスター海軍中将・ハラルドと共に駐在武官として乗り込むことに!一歩間違えば、世界大戦。国、大使館、貴族、マスコミ……あらゆるものを利用する、『英雄を必要としないため』の闘いが始まる。これは、国家の趨勢を懸けた駐在武官たちの本格外交業務戦記である!

altTitles.ja: 彼女の友達

altTitles.en: My Girlfriend's Friend

altTitles.vi: Bạn Của Bạn Gái Tôi

description.en: He got a cute girlfriend who was the first in his life, but her friend tempted him with a body that was lewder than her... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend pressed you like this?
description.ja: 人生で初めてできた、かわいい彼女。でもその友達は、彼女よりも豊満なカラダで僕を誘惑してきて…。彼女の友達にこんな風に迫られたら、あなたはどうしますか？
description.vi: Lần đầu tiên trong đời tôi có một cô bạn gái vô cùng dễ thương nhưng bạn cô ấy luôn cố dùng thân hình nóng bỏng của mình để cám dỗ tôi, phải làm sao đây?
description.pt-br: Ele arrumou uma namorada bonita que foi a primeira da vida dele, mas a amiga dela o tentou com um corpo mais lascivo que o dela... O que você faria se a amiga da sua namorada te pressionasse assim?

description.en:
In New Pantheon City, monstrous "Voids" have plagued the people for over 500 years. 

However, they are not without their protectors - Immortal Magical guardians are also there to fight back against them.

Living in New Pantheon City is Mars Hino - a troubled outcast. Because of his reputation, vulgar personality, and lack of social finesse, he has found himself entering high school alone. That is before he meets the hero of the Blunbell district, the magical girl Scarlet Star - who chooses him for a higher duty
description.id:
Di Kota New Pantheon, makhluk mengerikan bernama “Void” telah menghantui penduduknya selama lebih dari 500 tahun.

Namun, mereka tidak sepenuhnya tanpa pelindung — para penjaga magis abadi juga hadir untuk melawan ancaman tersebut.

Tinggal di Kota New Pantheon adalah Mars Hino — seorang penyendiri bermasalah. Karena reputasinya, kepribadiannya yang kasar, serta kurangnya kecakapan sosial, ia harus memasuki masa SMA sendirian. Namun semuanya berubah sebelum itu, ketika ia bertemu dengan pahlawan Distrik Blunbell, gadis penyihir Scarlet Star — yang memilihnya untuk menjalankan tugas yang lebih besar.

altTitles.ja: みゆちゃんはずっと友達

altTitles.en: Miyu-chan Will Always Be Your Friend

altTitles.pt-br: Miyu-chan Sempre Será sua Amiga

altTitles.es-la: Miyu-chan Siempre Será tu Amiga

description.en: In the summer of his second year of high school, Yuushin Tahara finds that his childhood friend, Miyu Fukagawa, who had moved away, has returned to the house next door. Although Miyu has grown up to be quite cute, there's something a little strange about her…
description.es: En el verano de su segundo año de instituto, su amiga de la infancia Miyu Fukagawa vuelve a la casa de al lado del protagonista, Yuushin Tahara, después de haberse separado cuando se mudó. Miyu-chan ha crecido y se ha vuelto mucho más guapa, pero hay algo un poco extraño en ella...? Se trata de una comedia de suspenso y amor con una nueva sensación, en la que el demasiado amable protagonista y su simpática pero muy divertida amiga de la infancia ¡se desenvuelven con sus amigos!
description.ja: 高校2年生の夏、主人公・田原優心の隣の家に、引っ越しで別れてしまった幼馴染・深川みゆちゃんが帰ってきた。すっかり大きく可愛くなったみゆちゃんだけど、どこかちょっとヘンで…？
description.zh: 在高二夏天，主人公·田原优心与小学毕业时因搬家被迫分别的青梅竹马·深川美羽重逢了。虽然长大后的美羽变得很可爱，但是哪里有点奇怪……？过于温柔的主人公，与惹人喜爱却处处充满疑点的青梅竹马之间展开的新颖青春恋爱悬疑喜剧！
description.es-la: En el verano de su segundo año de instituto, su amiga de la infancia Miyu Fukagawa vuelve a la casa de al lado del protagonista, Yuushin Tahara, después de haberse separado cuando se mudó. Miyu-chan ha crecido y se ha vuelto mucho más guapa, pero hay algo un poco extraño en ella...? Se trata de una comedia de suspenso y amor con una nueva sensación, en la que el demasiado amable protagonista y su simpática pero muy divertida amiga de la infancia ¡se desenvuelven con sus amigos!
description.pt-br:
No verão do seu segundo ano do ensino médio, Tahara Yuushin descobre que sua amiga de infância, Fukagawa Miyu, que havia se mudado, retornou para a casa ao lado. Embora Miyu tenha se tornado uma garota bastante fofa, há algo um pouco estranho sobre ela...

Uma comédia romântica com toques de suspense, centrada em um protagonista gentil e sua amiga de infância adorável, porém um tanto excêntrica.

title.ja-ro: Saikyou Onna Shishou-tachi ga Ikusei Houshin wo Megutte Shuraba

altTitles.ja: 最強女師匠たちが育成方針を巡って修羅場

altTitles.ja-ro: Saikyou Onna Shishou-tachi ga Ikusei Houshin o Megutte Shuraba

altTitles.en: Training Regimes of the World's Strongest Women

altTitles.ru: Сильнейшие наставницы в мире и их программа тренировок

altTitles.th: เหล่าอาจารย์สาวสุดแกร่งแย่งกันจะปั้นให้ผมเทพ

description.en:
There are three female masters who are known to be the strongest in the world. The only thing they can't get their hands on... their ideal man.

"If there are no ideal men, why not raise one ourselves!?"

As they skim over the list of candidates, the ladies' eyes all fixate on one boy. A level 0 with no shred of talent...
___
**Character Designer:** [Tajima Ryuushi](https://mangadex.org/author/3ac15f57-6a12-4018-b549-30aab86fc6c8)
description.ja:
世界最強クラスと称される三人の女傑。そんな彼女たちでも手に入らないモノ……それは―――理想の男！！

「好みの男がいないなら、自分で育てりゃいいじゃない！」

弟子――もとい、未来の旦那候補として彼女たちが目をつけたのは…才能の欠片もないレベル０の少年で…！？
